explain.aspect.squares-and-oppositions.s.source: All about the Aspects - Squares and Oppositions

explain.house.8.overview.title: All About the Eighth House in Astrology
explain.house.8.overview.text: The eighth house in astrology is a house that can seem kind of scary when you're first digging into it. This house contains a lot in its depths, and is the darkest of houses. But as always, shine a little light, and it's not quite so scary! (hopefully, anyway, ha)

explain.house.8.brief.title: 8th House Astrology: House of Shared Resources
explain.house.8.brief.text: The 8th house governs your shared finances and resources, so the things that don't only impact you (debts, loans, inheritances, taxes, joint finances, business partnerships, etc.). This house also governs your darker side, what you hold deep inside, and transformations. Planets in the 8th house can impact your sharing ability, your approach to transforming, and what you hold inside. This house is naturally ruled by Pluto and connects with the sign of Scorpio.
explain.house.8.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.8.natal.title: 8th House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.8.natal.text: Astrology charts have 12 houses, and each link to different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Each of your natal houses connects to different parts of your life and personality. The eighth house is ruled by Pluto, master of the dark arts. Pluto is deep, intense, passionate, profound, and sometimes frightening. So, it's not surprising that the house it connects with has this air to it!

explain.house.8.keywords.title: At-a-Glance 8th House Keywords:
explain.house.8.keywords.text: intense and passionate · transformation in all ways · sexuality · other people's money · what you hold deep inside · challenging emotions · magical

explain.house.8.k.intense-and-passionate.title: 8th House in Astrology: Intense and Passionate
explain.house.8.k.intense-and-passionate.text: The eighth house is a super intense part of your natal chart. It's passionate, just like its ruler Pluto. This can be channeled productively and used in a way that allows you to become an expert at some point. But, it can also be used for the bad too. This can become obsession, and it can be difficult to let go with the 8th house. Without a more positive purpose, it can kind of eat itself, so to speak. This energy needs direction, and it needs to be controlled as best as it can be.

explain.house.8.k.transformation-in-all-.title: 8th House in Astrology: Transformation in All Ways
explain.house.8.k.transformation-in-all-.text: The eighth house governs transformations, just as its ruler Pluto does. You'll often hear this house rules death - well, that's just seen as another transformation, going from one form to another. Pregnancy is also ruled by the eighth house, again another transformation (new life). Restoration and renovation, of buildings or cars or other objects, is also ruled by the eighth house (yet another transformation). You can see that the transformation can be literal and physical, but it also rules the transformations that are more subtle and internal. This house can show where we're constantly evolving, or where we must transform in big ways in our lives.

explain.house.8.k.sexuality.title: 8th House in Astrology: Sexuality
explain.house.8.k.sexuality.text:
The eighth house connects to sex. Some will say, oh no that's the 5th house! Well, both houses do. It's sort of seen as fifth house sex is more for fun, it's lighter, and casual sex would fall under the fifth house. eighth house sex is seen as more intense, more serious, and we technically say it rules "orgasmic sex

"

.

The "orgasmic sex

" rulership may come from orgasms being referred to as the "little

death" (in French it's "le petit mort") - so it could just be another transformation!

explain.house.8.k.other-people-s-money.title: 8th House in Astrology: Other People's Money
explain.house.8.k.other-people-s-money.text:
Astrology gives rulership of money to two houses, the second house and the eighth house. The second house rules your own money, so the money you make or have yourself, your own resources and what you spend on yourself. The eighth house rules other people's money, so this is any money or resources that impact or involve other people. Like:

- debt

- loans

- inheritances

- joint finances

- business finances

- taxes

- shared resources

Hence this house being called the house of death, sex, and taxes!

"Shared resources" can also mean beyond just money. It can be anything that is shared with others. This is another way the 8th house connects to sex (seen as "sharing your body

"

with another).

Also keep in mind with "inheritances"

- this doesn't necessarily have to mean

"money

"

. Most of us don't inherit money, but we do inherit something else, and that can be seen through the 8th house.

And, legacies can fall under the 8th house too, showing what you leave behind.

explain.house.8.k.what-you-hold-deep-ins.title: 8th House in Astrology: What You Hold Deep Inside
explain.house.8.k.what-you-hold-deep-ins.text:
Since the eighth house is so deep, it can be where we house what we shove away, what we don't want to face, what we're afraid to deal with. We push it further and further inside of the 8th house.

The darkness within, the demons inside us all, reside there. The traumas and baggage that we run from live with them. The longer they stay there, the bigger they become, the more they fester and spread, and the worse it gets for us. Obviously this isn't good, and we really need to face it before it consumes us.

explain.house.8.k.challenging-emotions.title: 8th House in Astrology: Challenging Emotions
explain.house.8.k.challenging-emotions.text:
With the darkness and intensity of the eighth house, it's no surprise it rules the emotions that we tend to find more challenging:

- envy

- jealousy

- rage

- hatred

- hostility

- vengeful

I describe these as "challenging" and not "bad" because they're not really bad. No emotions are, they're neutral, it's our actions that dictate whether they're good or bad. These just may not *feel* great, and tend to be the most challenging, and we use them as an excuse for bad behavior.

In typical eighth house fashion, we need to TRANSFORM these challenging emotions into something beneficial. If you're envious or jealous of someone or something, use that as fuel to inspire you. If you're full of rage and hostility, use that to motivate you to change. If you hate someone or something, recognize where that's coming from and what you can do about it. If you want revenge, look within for why you can't accept what is.

explain.house.8.k.magical.title: 8th House in Astrology: Magical
explain.house.8.k.magical.text: The eighth house rules the occult, and can be a place of magic. There's a real witchy side to this house. Power is ruled by the eighth house, and the witch can possess a deep well of power. The eighth house also wants to dig deeper, research and investigate, which can lead to great knowledge, so this house not only connects with the magic of the soul, but also the magic of science.

explain.house.8.where.title: Where Your Eighth House Energy is Found
explain.house.8.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your eighth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you can find the intensity, transformations, and more in your life. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your eighth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your eighth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 8th house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your eighth house, this can make the eighth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet has an extra degree of intensity, requires transformations, considers the darkness, but also some power in it.

Transit (moving) planets touring your eighth house can bring some temporary energy for eighth house matters. It'll be most intense when it's transit Saturn, since Saturn wants us to learn lessons, and we can become much more aware of the pain of our eighth house.

Transit planets aspecting your natal 8th house ruler can stimulate eighth house energy as well, and conjunctions, squares, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a LOT of focus. A major transformation is usually necessary.

explain.house.8.strong.title: A Strong Eighth House in Astrology
explain.house.8.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal eighth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 8th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 8th house

- your North or South Node in your 8th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 8th house

- your 8th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 8th house or ruling the 8th house When you have a strong 8th house, this means a few things. You may be more prone to hiding things away deep down, running from trauma and baggage. You may be prone to more challenging feelings at times. You may have a lot of power within, but are scared of it. You may share too much of yourself or your resources with others, and not keep enough for yourself.

What is most important for you is to transform. Eighth house people usually need to transform, either many times in smaller ways throughout your life, or one or two really huge times (or sometimes both!). It can be a long and hard road, but your potential is often much bigger. But, only if you can avoid total self-destruction!

explain.house.11.overview.title: All About the Eleventh House in Astrology
explain.house.11.overview.text: The eleventh house in astrology is a place of major change. It comes after the practical, goal-oriented tenth house, and finds new ways to go into the future. The eleventh house comes before the twelfth house, prepping us for the end.

explain.house.11.brief.title: 11th House Astrology: House of Dreams
explain.house.11.brief.text: The 11th house governs the dreams you have for your future and what you hope for in life. It also rules your friendships and groups you belong to, the causes your champion, and the changes you focus on. This house is highly independent and unconventional. Planets in the 11th house can impact your dreams, friends, causes, and independence. This house is naturally ruled by Uranus and connects with the sign of Aquarius.
explain.house.11.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.11.natal.title: 11th House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.11.natal.text: Astrology charts have 12 houses, and each link to different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Each of your natal houses connects to different parts of your life and personality. The eleventh house is ruled by Uranus, unconventional and iconic. Uranus helps the eleventh house color outside the lines and push outside of comfort zones.

explain.house.11.keywords.title: At-a-Glance 11th House Keywords:
explain.house.11.keywords.text: hopes and dreams · the unexpected · individuality · the unconventional · friends and groups · change · causes

explain.house.11.k.hopes-and-dreams-for-.title: 11th House in Astrology: Hopes and Dreams for the Future
explain.house.11.k.hopes-and-dreams-for-.text: The eleventh house in astrology rules your hopes and dreams for the future. How you find hope, what you dream of, and the kind of future you want to have can be found here. This is where you focus on what you want your future to look like, and what gives you hope.

explain.house.11.k.the-unexpected.title: 11th House in Astrology: The Unexpected
explain.house.11.k.the-unexpected.text:
The eleventh house in astrology is also an unexpected place. This is thanks to the fact it's governed by Uranus, and Uranus doesn't like to let things be the same or mundane. We can experience unexpected developments with the eleventh house, and we can almost crave this.

If things get too boring, we can go a little wonky with the eleventh house. The eleventh house wants sudden and unexpected, and can thrive under this.

explain.house.11.k.individuality.title: 11th House in Astrology: Individuality
explain.house.11.k.individuality.text: The eleventh house rules individuality and nonconformity. We're all unique individuals, no one else is just like us, and this house embraces that. The eleventh house is where we're true to ourselves and embrace what makes is different How well you embrace your differences, how much you embrace individuality, and whether you're comfortable with it or not can be found with this house.

explain.house.11.k.the-unconventional.title: 11th House in Astrology: The Unconventional
explain.house.11.k.the-unconventional.text:
The eleventh house rules the unconventional. Its previous house, the tenth house, is traditional and the way things have always been. The eleventh house wants to gut that and push outside of comfort zones to find more room for growth.

The eleventh house wants to explore what's different, what's way out there, to find even more for our lives. How comfortable you are with this and how much you need to go against the grain and with what can be found here.

explain.house.11.k.friends-and-groups.title: 11th House in Astrology: Friends and Groups
explain.house.11.k.friends-and-groups.text: The eleventh house rules your friends, and the kind of people you attract as friends, the nature of your friendships, and your approach to friendships can be found here. The eleventh house also rules groups, so this can be the groups you belong to and participate in, as well as how comfortable you are in groups and before the masses. The famous among us can often have strong eleventh houses.

explain.house.11.k.change.title: 11th House in Astrology: Change
explain.house.11.k.change.text:
The eleventh house connects to change thanks to being ruled by Uranus, the planet of change. We don't like things to stay the same with the eleventh house. What you need to change, your approach to change, and the changes you experience can be found here, along with your Uranus.

How comfortable you are with changes, and how you make changes yourself, can be found with the eleventh house.

explain.house.11.k.causes.title: 11th House in Astrology: Causes
explain.house.11.k.causes.text:
The eleventh house rules our causes, and these are the causes that we invest ourselves in, where we want to have a broad impact on the masses, the collective. This can be seen as a way of making a mark that lasts long after us, and can be used to help us connect with like-minded people.

Your approach to causes, the causes you pick up, and how you manage them can be found with this house. This is where you care about the most people as a whole and want to have a larger impact, whereas the twelfth house is where you want to help one person at a time.

explain.house.11.where.title: Where Your Eleventh House Energy is Found
explain.house.11.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your eleventh house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you can change, be unconventional, and dream. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your eleventh house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your eleventh house falls in) as this can also connect to the eleventh house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your eleventh house, this can make the eleventh house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet has a strong impact on your dreams, your individuality, and your friends.

Transit (moving) planets touring your eleventh house can bring some temporary energy for eleventh house matters. This can impact your ability to have hope, pursue your dreams, and be true to yourself. Transit Saturn may be the most difficult since it's such different energy and restrictive, and you may have lessons to learn around being who you are and embracing what's different.

Transit planets aspecting your natal eleventh house ruler can stimulate eleventh house energy as well, and conjunctions, squares, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and impact your future and individuality. You may feel stifled, want to give up on your dreams, and have difficulties with friends.

explain.house.11.strong.title: A Strong Eleventh House in Astrology
explain.house.11.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal second house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 11th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 11th house

- your North or South Node in your 11th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 11th house

- your 11th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 11th house or ruling the 11th house When you have a strong 11th house, this can mean your future is super important to you, and you can have big dreams and be hopeful about what you're capable of building. You can also embrace change, and likely need quite a bit of it in your life or you get bored quickly.

You're a true individual, and you need to celebrate what makes you so unique. Boxing yourself in only hurts you severely. But friends are also important for you, so you're someone who needs to both be true to yourself, and also finds your place where you can be true to yourself, with others who celebrate your true self.

explain.house.5.overview.title: All About the Fifth House in Astrology
explain.house.5.overview.text: The fifth house in astrology is one of the pleasant parts of your natal chart, as it connects to love and your heart, what you find fun, romance, and play.

explain.house.5.brief.title: 5th House Astrology: House of Love
explain.house.5.brief.text: The 5th house governs love, both who you love (and date, as well as your children) and what you love (your hobbies). This house is a creative house and focuses on the lighter side. Planets in the 5th house can impact your hobbies, your love life, your children, and your creative side. This house is naturally ruled by the Sun and connects with the sign of Leo.
explain.house.5.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.5.natal.title: Fifth House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.5.natal.text:
Most astrology charts have 12 houses, and each rule different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and 12 houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Your natal houses each rule different parts of your life and personality.

The fifth house is naturally ruled by the Sun, which rules our true selves. The Sun makes the fifth house an expressive house, one where our true joy can be found.

explain.house.5.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Fifth House Keywords:
explain.house.5.keywords.text: love & romance · children · hobbies · creativity · attention · praise & approval

explain.house.5.k.love-romance.title: Fifth House in Astrology: Love & Romance
explain.house.5.k.love-romance.text:
The fifth house is the house of love. This is where we fall in love, the kind of love we want and need, and how we are in dating and with romance. This is light-hearted love, not serious (which is the eighth house) or committed (which is the seventh house).

The fifth house shows the people we love, as well as the things we love to do. This is a heart-centric house.

explain.house.5.k.children.title: Fifth House in Astrology: Children
explain.house.5.k.children.text:
The fifth house rules who we love, and is a house of creation, so our children are ruled by the fifth house. Sometimes they literally tie into the sign of your fifth house or planets in the fifth house.

This can also be your inner child, how it comes out, and what it needs. Fifth house transits can trigger getting in tune with your inner child.

explain.house.5.k.hobbies.title: Fifth House in Astrology: Hobbies
explain.house.5.k.hobbies.text: Since the fifth house rules what we love, this house rules our hobbies. It's what we enjoy doing most, what brings us joy and pleasure. It's where we can let loose and have fun without rules or anything serious.

explain.house.5.k.creativity.title: Fifth House in Astrology: Creativity
explain.house.5.k.creativity.text: The fifth house is a house of creation, governing creativity. It can show in what ways you are creative, how you display creative energy, and where you focus your creativity. A strong fifth house often means someone is a super creative person (and remember, creativity doesn't have to mean the arts!).

explain.house.5.k.attention.title: Fifth House in Astrology: Attention
explain.house.5.k.attention.text: The fifth house rules getting attention. Being naturally ruled by the Sun, the Sun shines a light, so this house can show how you get attention, what you get attention for, how you feel about getting attention, and where you may get attention.

explain.house.5.k.praise-approval.title: Fifth House in Astrology: Praise & Approval
explain.house.5.k.praise-approval.text: Praise and approval are also ruled by the fifth house, and it can show how or where you need praise and approval from others, as well as how you give it to others.

explain.house.5.where.title: Where Your Fifth House Energy is Found
explain.house.5.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your fifth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you're creative and enjoy yourself. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your fifth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your fifth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 5th house energy. If you have any natal planets in your fifth house, this can make the fifth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet can strongly connect with your creativity, hobbies, and what you enjoy.

Transit (moving) planets touring your fifth house can bring some temporary energy for fifth house matters. It can be especially strong when it's transit Mars (amplifying creativity and making you more affectionate and loving), transit Saturn (making you more discriminating in love and where you direct your hobbies), transit Uranus (making changes in your love relationships and with what you enjoy), transit Pluto (bringing out power struggles and control issues in love and transforming love), or transit Chiron (focusing on healing wounds of love).

Transit planets aspecting your natal 5th house ruler can stimulate fifth house energy as well, and conjunctions, square, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a lot of focus on opening up your heart, taking care of your inner child, and working on old love issues to make love healthier and more positive for you.

explain.house.5.strong.title: A Strong Fifth House in Astrology
explain.house.5.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal fifth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 5th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 5th house

- your North or South Node in your 5th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 5th house

- your 5th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 5th house or ruling the 5th house When you have a strong 5th house, you can be a super creative, and likely have some serious creative talents. This may be something you get attention for, and it's fairly common to see celebs have strong 5th houses.

You may also feel a strong connection to your children or the children around you, and you may be a natural parent. You can understand how kids operate, and can be highly encouraging and supportive of them.

Making time to enjoy yourself and have fun can be very important for your overall well-being. If you're all work and no play, you can seem stifled in life, like your light is dimmed. You need to prioritize joy!

explain.house.1.overview.title: All About the First House in Astrology
explain.house.1.overview.text: The first house in astrology is a house that is full of energy and excitement. It's the very first house, the very beginning of our houses, and where it all starts for you.

explain.house.1.brief.title: 1st House Astrology: House of the Self
explain.house.1.brief.text: The 1st house governs you overall, and shows your outer self. This is the face you put out into the world, and it's the way people see you. We tend to play up the positives of the sign on the 1st house cusp so we can put our best foot forward. Planets in the 1st house can also be apparent in your outward personality. This house is naturally ruled by Mars and connects with the sign of Aries.
explain.house.1.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.1.natal.title: First House in Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.1.natal.text:
Most astrology charts have 12 houses, and each rule different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and 12 houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Your natal houses each rule different parts of your life and personality.

The first house is naturally ruled by Mars, ruler of energy and drive. Mars is the fiery planet, and needs constant movement forward.

explain.house.1.keywords.title: At-a-glance First House Keywords:
explain.house.1.keywords.text: new beginnings · outer self · energy · initiative · attention · self-focus · gut instincts

explain.house.1.k.new-beginnings.title: First House in Astrology: New Beginnings
explain.house.1.k.new-beginnings.text: The first house is the very first house out of the 12 houses, so it relates to new beginnings. This is the house where new ventures, new projects, and new journeys begin. There can be excitement for it, and triggers and catalysts can be strong.

explain.house.1.k.outer-self.title: First House in Astrology: Outer Self
explain.house.1.k.outer-self.text:
The first house is part of the triad along with your Sun and Moon, and this trio are the basis for you, who you are, and your life. The Sun is your true self, the Moon is your emotional self, and the first house is your outer self.

This is how you come across when you meet people. We all wear masks when we're out with others and strangers, and that mask is your first house.

This can be shown via the sign your first house is in, but also via planets located in your first house.

explain.house.1.k.energy.title: First House in Astrology: Energy
explain.house.1.k.energy.text: The first house is a house full of energy and enthusiasm. It's the first house, so it's brand new, full of zest for life, and ready to go.

explain.house.1.k.initiative.title: First House in Astrology: Initiative
explain.house.1.k.initiative.text:
The first house can show taking initiative for what you want for yourself. It's less focused on others and more about you, and your own desires.

You can take the energy and enthusiasm you have and use that to make things happen. You don't need to wait for others, or for permission. On the downside, this can mean impatience is an issue.

explain.house.1.k.attention.title: First House in Astrology: Attention
explain.house.1.k.attention.text: Since the first house connects to your outer self and how you come across, it also can be a place that gets a lot of external attention. This is attention you can get for what you put out there yourself, and you can be comfortable with the attention you get.

explain.house.1.k.self-focus.title: First House in Astrology: Self-Focus
explain.house.1.k.self-focus.text:
The first house is focused on you, and not so much about others. Since this is a basic part of who you are in astrology, it can be an area where you're giving yourself attention, focusing on your own wants and needs.

Your relationship with yourself can be found here as well, and how you connect with yourself, or can in a healthy way.

explain.house.1.k.gut-instincts.title: First House in Astrology: Gut Instincts
explain.house.1.k.gut-instincts.text:
The twelfth house rules intuition, the fourth house rules emotional instincts, but the first house connects with gut instincts, the very first thing you feel. You can jump to act based on these instincts.

Whether or not they're actually honed can depend on the condition of your first house as well as your natal Mars.

explain.house.1.where.title: Where Your First House Energy is Found
explain.house.1.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your first house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you have gut instincts, energy, focus on yourself, and take initiative for new beginnings. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your first house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your first house falls in) as this can also connect to the 1st house energy (and is also usually considered your chart ruler).

If you have any natal planets in your first house, this can make the first house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet can impact how you come across, and you may seem more like that than the sign sometimes.

Transit (moving) planets touring your first house can bring some temporary energy for first house matters. It can be especially strong when it's transit Mars (bringing extra energy and drive), transit Saturn (restricting you so you learn), transit Uranus (causing personal changes), transit Pluto (bringing transformations), or transit Chiron (focusing on healing ego wounds).

Transit planets aspecting your natal 1st house ruler can stimulate first house energy as well, and conjunctions, square, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a lot of focus on yourself.

explain.house.1.strong.title: A Strong First House in Astrology
explain.house.1.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal first house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 1st house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 1st house

- your North or South Node in your 1st house

- your 1st house ruler in the 1st house

- your 1st house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 1st house or ruling the 1st house When you have a strong 1st house, you can give yourself extra attention, and prioritize your own wants and needs. This can be good, until it develops into selfishness or being an egomaniac. You need to make sure you're considering others.

You can feel extra drawn to new beginnings, and may have little trouble pursuing new ventures. The problem is that without other things in the chart to ground you, you may not see things through to the end, and have a lot started, but nothing finished.

You may be someone who gets a lot of attention for your personality, looks, or some other way in which you come across. You may need to work more on having a rounded personality and life, and not focusing solely on how you come across.

explain.house.4.overview.title: All About the Fourth House in Astrology
explain.house.4.overview.text: The fourth house in astrology is a house that can seem quiet on the surface, but has a lot of emotional depth. It's the very core of any chart, and shows the foundation, the roots, and the basics.

explain.house.4.brief.title: 4th House Astrology: House of Home & Family
explain.house.4.brief.text: The 4th house governs your home and family life, the ones you're born into and the ones you create as an adult. It shows what you want/need at home and from family, and your roots. This house also shows your internal foundation. Planets in the 4th house can impact your home and family life and foundation. This house is naturally ruled by the Moon and connects with the sign of Cancer.
explain.house.4.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.4.natal.title: Fourth House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.4.natal.text:
Most astrology charts have 12 houses, and each rule different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and 12 houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Your natal houses each rule different parts of your life and personality.

The fourth house is naturally ruled by the Moon, ruler of emotion. The Moon ebbs and flows with emotion, and is a sensitive planet. It craves security and stability in order to flourish.

explain.house.4.keywords.title: At-a-glance Fourth House Keywords:
explain.house.4.keywords.text: internal foundation · home and home environment · family · roots · emotion · early life · instinct

explain.house.4.k.internal-foundation.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Internal Foundation
explain.house.4.k.internal-foundation.text:
The fourth house is the very bottom of any chart, and in your natal chart, represents your internal foundation. This is the foundation for who you are as a person, as well as for your life.

What you need to have a strong foundation, and what can shake your foundation, can be seen via your fourth house.

explain.house.4.k.home-home-environment.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Home & Home Environment
explain.house.4.k.home-home-environment.text: The fourth house rules your home and home life, and can show what your ideal home and home life looks like, what you need from where you live, and how this environment is. This is the place you come home to in your natal chart. There is a degree of comfort and familiarity to the fourth house because of this, and a craving for safety and security is strong.

explain.house.4.k.family.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Family
explain.house.4.k.family.text:
The fourth house rules your family, both the family you're born into and the family you create, so those you think of as family. This is a part of our support system, and helps to create the safety and security needed.

It's believed that your parents are ruled by the 4th and 10th houses, with one ruling one parent and one ruling the other.

explain.house.4.k.roots.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Roots
explain.house.4.k.roots.text: Since the fourth house connects to family, the home, and the internal foundation, it also rules our roots. Where or how we put down roots, and what connects us in a grounded way. The fourth house can get us back to our roots, back to basics.

explain.house.4.k.emotion.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Emotion
explain.house.4.k.emotion.text:
The fourth house is ruled by the Moon, so this house connects with emotion. It's virtually any and all emotions, and we can feel them intensely, but may keep them to ourselves.

The fourth house can be sad, angry, depressed, but also happy, inspired, and creative. There can be a surprising amount of creativity associated with this house.

explain.house.4.k.early-life.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Early Life
explain.house.4.k.early-life.text:
With the fourth house connecting to our family, home, foundation, and roots, it's no surprise it also connects to our early life. The experiences of our early life and childhood, and what were the big themes we had to deal with.

This can leave an imprint on us for the rest of our lives, impacting our internal foundation and core selves.

explain.house.4.k.instinct.title: Fourth House in Astrology: Instinct
explain.house.4.k.instinct.text:
There can also be a surprising amount of instinct associated with the fourth house in astrology. This house is so basic, so at our core, and so connected to emotion, that it intensifies intuition.

We may operate in an instinctive manner with the 4th house, and ebb and flow based on what our intuition tells us.

explain.house.4.where.title: Where Your Fourth House Energy is Found
explain.house.4.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your fourth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where your foundation is located, emotions and instinct are used, and your home and family lies. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your fourth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your fourth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 4th house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your fourth house, this can make the fourth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet has an extra degree of emotion, intuition, and is a part of your foundation.

Transit (moving) planets touring your fourth house can bring some temporary energy for fourth house matters. It can be especially strong when it's transit Mars (bringing energy and amplifying aggression), transit Saturn (pushing down emotion), transit Uranus (causing unexpected outbursts), transit Pluto (bringing out intensity), or transit Chiron (focusing on healing emotional wounds).

Transit planets aspecting your natal 4th house ruler can stimulate fourth house energy as well, and conjunctions, square, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a lot of focus on your internal self.

explain.house.4.strong.title: A Strong Fourth House in Astrology
explain.house.4.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal fourth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 4th house

99- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 4th house

- your North or South Node in your 4th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 4th house

- your 4th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 4th house or ruling the 4th house When you have a strong 4th house, your foundation may have extra challenges you need to work through, however once you do, you can be so strong internally that no one can take you down. It's getting to that point that's difficult.

Your home and family and early life were likely super important to your development, and you may harbor some old issues related to that. You may need to tackle them at the core to get rid of them.

Your intuition can be very strong, and you can be quite creative. But emotional mood swings may throw you off easily, and you have to get some control over your feelings.

explain.axis.overview.title: Pairs of Houses in Astrology
explain.axis.overview.text: A standard astrology chart has 10 planets (including the Sun and Moon and excluding Earth), and 12 houses. The houses each govern a different part of your life and personality, and each house is exactly opposite another house in the Zodiac, so we have 6 pairs of houses. Each house pair is an axis, and each axis has its own energy.
explain.axis.overview.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.q.what-are-the-6-pairs-of-h.title: What are the 6 pairs of houses?
explain.axis.q.what-are-the-6-pairs-of-h.text:
The 6 pairs of houses in astrology are:

1st and 7th

2nd and 8th

3rd and 9th

4th and 10th

5th and 11th

6th and 12th
explain.axis.q.what-are-the-6-pairs-of-h.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.1-7.title: The 1st and 7th houses: Axis of Relationships
explain.axis.1-7.text: The 1st house represents the self, while the 7th house represents others. Depending on the house system you use (method of calculating house positions), the 1st house cusp is the Ascendant and 7th house cusp is the Descendant. This axis shows how you connect with yourself and with others. Planets in the 1st house impact you and your personality, while planets in the 7th house impact the people in your life and your relationships.
explain.axis.1-7.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.2-8.title: The 2nd and 8th houses: Axis of Money/Resources
explain.axis.2-8.text: The 2nd house represents your money and your resources, while the 8th house represents other people's money and shared resources. This axis shows how you give to yourself and to others, and what you keep and what you share. Planets in the 2nd house impact your financial attitude and how you make money, while planets in the 8th house impact how you share what you have and what resources others have you have access to.
explain.axis.2-8.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.3-9.title: The 3rd and 9th houses: Axis of Communication & Activity
explain.axis.3-9.text: The 3rd house represents your mind, how you learn and express yourself personally, while the 9th house represents how you build on and utilize knowledge, and shape your beliefs. This axis shows how you develop your mental abilities, how you put that out into the world, and is an active axis governing travel (short - 3rd; far - 9th). Planets in the 3rd house impact your general learning and communication abilities, while planets in the 9th house impact how you learn through experience and expansion.
explain.axis.3-9.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.4-10.title: The 4th and 10th houses: Axis of Foundation
explain.axis.4-10.text: The 4th house represents your home and family life and your core self, while the 10th house represents your goals and ambitions. Depending on the house system you use, the 4th house cusp is the Imum Coeli and the 10th house cusp is the Midheaven. This axis shows how you build a foundation in your life, internally (4th) and externally (10th). Planets in the 4th house impact your personal life and emotional needs, while planets in the 10th house impact your professional life and what you strive for.
explain.axis.4-10.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.5-11.title: The 5th and 11th houses: Axis of Connection
explain.axis.5-11.text: The 5th house represents love, both who and what you love, while the 11th house represents your friends and casual connections, causes and future dreams. This axis shows how you connect with others in a personal way (5th) and in a broad way (11th). Planets in the 5th house impact your love relationships and how you show love, while planets in the 11th house impact your social circle.
explain.axis.5-11.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.axis.6-12.title: The 6th and 12th houses: Axis of Service
explain.axis.6-12.text:
The 6th house represents the work you do, your daily life, and how you get things done, while the 12th house represents what you do for others, what you sacrifice, and your compassion and empathy. This axis shows how you serve, in small ways and more for the self (6th) and in bigger ways and all for others (12th). Planets in the 6th house impact your productivity and can be more realistic, while planets in the 12th house impact your compassion and imagination.

One note: If you have planets in one house of an axis and not the other house of the axis, you may lean more toward the one with planets. The one with planets gets more of your attention, and you have to work on using the energy properly while not ignoring the other house. There may be an imbalance of attention with the axis, and evening that can be important.
explain.axis.6-12.source: All about the Houses - House Pairings

explain.house.9.overview.title: All About the Ninth House in Astrology
explain.house.9.overview.text: The ninth house in astrology is a happy house, and one of the more positive areas of your natal chart. This isn't a dark and depressing place, this is a light and happy one.

explain.house.9.brief.title: 9th House Astrology: House of Higher Learning
explain.house.9.brief.text: The 9th house governs higher learning, so the learning you do beyond the basics (colleges and universities and specialized learning). This house rules expansion, so this can be expansion of the mind through learning, or through life experience and travel. It also rules your beliefs. Planets in the 9th house can impact your beliefs and ability to expand or what you need space with. This house is naturally ruled by Jupiter and connects with the sign of Sagittarius.
explain.house.9.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.9.natal.title: Ninth House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.9.natal.text:
Most astrology charts have 12 houses, and each rule different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and 12 houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Your natal houses each rule different parts of your life and personality.

The ninth house is naturally ruled by Jupiter, the happy planet ruling expansion. Jupiter wants to go big, and doesn't see the point in being serious or down about life when there are so many possibilities.

explain.house.9.keywords.title: At-a-glance Ninth House Keywords:
explain.house.9.keywords.text: expansion · higher learning · long-distance travel · beliefs · the big picture · optimism · bold communications

explain.house.9.k.expansion.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Expansion
explain.house.9.k.expansion.text: The ninth house is a house of expansion since it's ruled by Jupiter. It can show how we expand, where we focus on expanding, and what we want to expand. We can be open and willing to pursue opportunities with the ninth house, and want to see what else there is out there.

explain.house.9.k.higher-learning.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Higher Learning
explain.house.9.k.higher-learning.text: The ninth house is the house of higher learning, so this is learning beyond your primary education. It can show where we gain a lot of knowledge, and this knowledge can come conventionally in school, but also through life experience. Life can be the best teacher according to the ninth house.

explain.house.9.k.long-distance-travel.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Long-distance Travel
explain.house.9.k.long-distance-travel.text: The ninth house rules long-distance travel, so these are places you can't get to by car or walking. Airplane travel is ruled by the ninth house, and this house can show your approach to long-distance travel, how you want to do it, where you want to go, and what you gain from it.

explain.house.9.k.beliefs.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Beliefs
explain.house.9.k.beliefs.text: The ninth house is the house of beliefs, and astrology differentiates between your values with the second house and spirituality with the twelfth house. The ninth house is political beliefs, but also religious ones (different from spirituality, which isn't necessarily religion-connected).

explain.house.9.k.big-picture.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Big Picture
explain.house.9.k.big-picture.text: The ninth house is a big picture house. It can show your approach to the big picture, where you need the big picture, and how you can also think bigger and brighter.

explain.house.9.k.optimism.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Optimism
explain.house.9.k.optimism.text: The ninth house in astrology is an optimistic house thanks to Jupiter, and it can show how we're optimistic, what we're optimistic about, and our approach to being optimistic. It's where we don't want to be serious, and instead are adventurous, daring, and bold.

explain.house.9.k.bold-communications.title: Ninth House in Astrology: Bold Communications
explain.house.9.k.bold-communications.text: The ninth house is a communication house (along with the third house), but this is big, bold communication. It's grand storytelling, and rules publishing, marketing, and publicity.

explain.house.9.where.title: Where Your Ninth House Energy is Found
explain.house.9.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your ninth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you need space, think big, and are optimistic. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your ninth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your ninth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 9th house energy. If you have any natal planets in your ninth house, this can make the ninth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet can strongly connect with your expansion, learning, travel, and beliefs.

Transit (moving) planets touring your ninth house can bring some temporary energy for ninth house matters. It can be especially strong when it's transit Mars (drive for expansion), transit Saturn (lessons with beliefs), transit Uranus (unconventional beliefs), transit Pluto (powerful bold communications), or transit Chiron (focusing on healing wounds of expansion, optimism, or beliefs).

Transit planets aspecting your natal 9th house ruler can stimulate ninth house energy as well, and conjunctions, square, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a lot of focus on your beliefs and expansion.

explain.house.9.strong.title: A Strong Ninth House in Astrology
explain.house.9.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal ninth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 9th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 9th house

- your North or South Node in your 9th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 9th house

- your 9th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 9th house or ruling the 9th house When you have a strong 9th house, your beliefs can be super important for you, and you may be a staunch defender of the beliefs you have. You may struggle if the beliefs you grew up with aren't the ones you identify with as an adult, and have to work to be true to yourself.

You may be someone who needs a lot of space to expand and explore the world, and learning can best be done for you when you're experiencing life for yourself. This may lead to a lot of failures, but you end up lucking your way into something better.

You can see the bright side to most situations, and you can see the big picture relatively easily. This opens up opportunities to you all of the time.

explain.house.2.overview.title: All About the Second House in Astrology
explain.house.2.overview.text: The second house in astrology is a solid, stable, grounded house. It comes after the action-packed first house, where we begin, so the second house is where we build on that and get ready for the changes in the third house.

explain.house.2.brief.title: 2nd House Astrology: House of Finances
explain.house.2.brief.text: The 2nd house governs your money, and can show both how you make and spend money. This is your own money rather than the money impacting others (8th house). This house also shows your values, and what impacts stability and security in your life. Planets in the 2nd house can impact your financial life, values, and confidence. This house is naturally ruled by Venus and connects with the sign of Taurus.
explain.house.2.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.2.natal.title: 2nd House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.2.natal.text: Astrology charts have 12 houses, and each link to different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Each of your natal houses connects to different parts of your life and personality. The 2nd house is ruled by Venus, sensual and pragmatic. The 2nd house gets Venus's earthy side. Since the 2nd house connects to Taurus, Ceres can also connect to the 2nd house (argued to be the real ruler of Taurus). Ceres is nurturing and resourceful.

explain.house.2.keywords.title: At-a-Glance 2nd House Keywords:
explain.house.2.keywords.text: resources and money · values · self-confidence and self-esteem · worth · stability and security · physical and sensual · abundant

explain.house.2.k.resources-and-money.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Resources and Money
explain.house.2.k.resources-and-money.text:
The second house in astrology is best known as the house of money. The eighth house also connects with money, but the eighth house is other people's money (money you share or earn with others), whereas the second house is your own money.

The second house is your own resources, so this includes money but goes beyond that. It's your possessions, anything you own and is yours, so this can include material possessions and even things like property (though that is firstly governed by the fourth house).

explain.house.2.k.values.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Values
explain.house.2.k.values.text: The second house is also widely known as the house of values. This means the values you have in life. Whether you abide by them or not is a whole other story (LOL! but the condition of your second house may show whether or not you do). This ties the second house to the ninth house (which are your philosophical, political and religious beliefs) and the twelfth house (which are your spiritual beliefs). You can see how astrology splits these things up.

explain.house.2.k.self-confidence-and-se.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Self-Confidence and Self-Esteem
explain.house.2.k.self-confidence-and-se.text:
The second house connects to confidence and how you feel about yourself. The first house also connects to confidence, but it's more blustery than the second house. This is where your true levels of self-esteem lie.

What makes you feel confident and good about yourself, how you can improve your confidence and self-esteem, and what can make your confidence and self-esteem take a hit can all be in your second house.

explain.house.2.k.worth.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Worth
explain.house.2.k.worth.text:
This connects a little with the second house ruling your values and your self-esteem, so the second house also rules worth. This is self-worth as well as what you find worthy of your time, attention, money, and resources.

What you value is often tied to what you feel is worth your time, and your own self-esteem is often tied to your feelings of self-worth. This is found via your second house.

explain.house.2.k.stability-and-security.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Stability and Security
explain.house.2.k.stability-and-security.text:
The second house is a grounded house, and governs our stability and security. Along with the Moon, the second house shows what we need for stability and security, and what this can look like for us.

A challenging second house can show a life of ups and downs, lessons in going with the flow and embracing chaos; an easy second house can show an easy life (or at least easier, relatively speaking).

explain.house.2.k.physical-and-sensual.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Physical and Sensual
explain.house.2.k.physical-and-sensual.text:
The second house is a physical house. Remember it's ruled by Venus, a sensual planet connected to the physical world. The second house isn't a house of big thinking or feeling. It's instead a house of being connected to the physical body and physical world.

This means your senses are governed by the second house, and sensuality is here (not to be confused with sexuality, which is the eighth house; again, see how astrology splits them up). The physical world around us connects to the second house (along with the sixth house).

explain.house.2.k.abundant.title: 2nd House in Astrology: Abundant
explain.house.2.k.abundant.text: The second house is where we find abundance (along with asteroid Abundantia and planet Jupiter). This ties into the second house connecting to the physical world and ruling our resources. Second house abundance can be with money (often if you have your natal Venus, Ceres, or Jupiter here), but it can also tie to other things depending on the sign the second house falls in, planets in the house, and what the second house ruler is up to.

explain.house.2.where.title: Where Your Second House Energy is Found
explain.house.2.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your second house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you can focus on your resources, stability, and worth. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your second house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your second house falls in) as this can also connect to the 2nd house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your second house, this can make the second house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet has a strong impact on your resources, what you value, your confidence, and your stability.

Transit (moving) planets touring your second house can bring some temporary energy for second house matters. This often directly impacts your finances or resources in some way, and your attitude and approach to them, as well as to your confidence and values. Transit Pluto in the second house is the strongest and most notorious, as Pluto can strip your life down to the studs, removing anything false that has propped up your self-esteem or made you feel secure, and force you to start over.

Transit planets aspecting your natal 2nd house ruler can stimulate second house energy as well, and conjunctions, squares, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and impact your confidence and resources. You have to work on having healthy security and self-esteem, and being smart with resources.

explain.house.2.strong.title: A Strong Second House in Astrology
explain.house.2.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal second house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 2nd house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 2nd house

- your North or South Node in your 2nd house

- your 1st house ruler in the 2nd house

- your 2nd house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 2nd house or ruling the 2nd house When you have a strong 2nd house, this can mean your resources and money are super important for you. You need to get money squared away and feel like you have enough resources to make you feel safe and secure. Without that, you can be on edge constantly, and can either be extra stubborn, refusing to budge out of fear, or extra wandering, lacking any certainty to stay put.

Having solid self-confidence and bringing stability into your life is really important. It may be tempting to base these things off of something physical, but you likely need to learn how to feel good about yourself independent of anything physical. This creates sustainable security, and eventually sustainable abundance.

explain.house.7.overview.title: All About the Seventh House in Astrology
explain.house.7.overview.text: The seventh house in astrology is where we connect with others. It's the people in our lives, the partnerships we make, and we go from all about work with the sixth house to forming connections with the seventh house, which then deepens with the eighth house.

explain.house.7.brief.title: 7th House Astrology: House of Relationships
explain.house.7.brief.text: The 7th house governs your relationships in general, and the people in your life. It can show how you approach relationships, partnerships, and commitment, and what you want and need from others, the kind of people you attract, and what you're willing to give. Planets in the 7th house can impact your relationships and the people you encounter. This house is naturally ruled by Venus and connects with the sign of Libra.
explain.house.7.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.7.natal.title: 7th House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.7.natal.text: Astrology charts have 12 houses, and each link to different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Each of your natal houses connects to different parts of your life and personality. The 7th house is ruled by Venus, the planet of love and relationships. Venus and the 7th house are generally where you focus first and foremost with relationship astrology.

explain.house.7.keywords.title: At-a-Glance 7th House Keywords:
explain.house.7.keywords.text: committed relationships and partnerships · other people · compromise · balance · fairness and justice · equality · peace and harmony

explain.house.7.k.committed-relationship.title: 7th House in Astrology: Committed Relationships and Partnerships
explain.house.7.k.committed-relationship.text:
The seventh house in astrology is best known for being the house of committed relationships and partnerships. These are the relationships we take seriously, and the people we're close to. This can include marriage and similar types of commitment, as well as business partnerships where you're more or less equals (ones where you're not fall under the eighth house).

This house (along with Venus) can show who you attract into your life, what you want and need in committed relationships, and what you give in a committed relationship.

explain.house.7.k.other-people.title: 7th House in Astrology: Other People
explain.house.7.k.other-people.text: The seventh house, generally, rules the other people in your life. This means all of them! Whenever you're having dealings with others, this is a seventh house matter (combined with whatever else rules the dealing specifically). Each house rules a specific relationship, but the seventh house is all of them in general. The seventh house shows those you're committed to, but also people who may come in and out of your life.

explain.house.7.k.compromise.title: 7th House in Astrology: Compromise
explain.house.7.k.compromise.text:
The seventh house governs compromise, and is the house where you want to meet in the middle. It's the house ruling negotiation and mediation. This is where you want to find middle ground and are willing to compromise.

The sign of your seventh house can show how you approach compromise and how well you negotiate.

explain.house.7.k.balance.title: 7th House in Astrology: Balance
explain.house.7.k.balance.text:
The seventh house is on an axis with the first house, and they cut right through the very middle of the Zodiac wheel and any astrology chart. This is the axis of connections, but because of its placement, it's also focused on balance, and that's mostly funneled to the seventh house.

The seventh house can show what you need in order to feel balanced, your approach to balance, and what balance looks like for you.

explain.house.7.k.fairness-and-justice.title: 7th House in Astrology: Fairness and Justice
explain.house.7.k.fairness-and-justice.text:
The seventh house rules fairness and justice, so it does tie into the law (which is ruled by the ninth house). This is where we need to fight fair, and fight for justice, and where justice is more true to its ideal rather than seeking revenge or punishment (which is more eighth house).

The seventh house can show where you feel more fairness and justice is needed and how you approach this.

explain.house.7.k.equality.title: 7th House in Astrology: Equality
explain.house.7.k.equality.text:
The seventh house in astrology also rules equality. This is not where our connections are unequal (which can be the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses), and instead, are the connections where we're on equal ground.

The seventh house can show where you strive for equality, how you approach it, and what it looks like for you.

explain.house.7.k.peace-and-harmony.title: 7th House in Astrology: Peace and Harmony
explain.house.7.k.peace-and-harmony.text:
The seventh house governs peace and harmony, and this is the house where we're anti-war and don't want to fight. That's partly why we compromise and strive for fairness with this house, since that can lead to peace and harmony.

The seventh house can show where you need peace and harmony, what you can do to get it, and how you can maintain it.

explain.house.7.where.title: Where Your Seventh House Energy is Found
explain.house.7.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your seventh house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign can tie into your connections. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your seventh house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your seventh house falls in) as this can also connect to the 7th house energy. If you have any natal planets in your seventh house, this can make the seventh house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet has a strong impact on your relationships, and may play a key role in the connections you make and with the people you attract.

Transit (moving) planets touring your seventh house can bring some temporary energy for seventh house matters. This often directly impacts your relationships, commitments, and dealings with others. Transit Saturn in the seventh house might be the most difficult as Saturn is a restrictive planet ruling lessons, so many people tend to exit your life with transit Saturn touring your 7th house, and this can be upsetting initially, but it's usually the people that weren't good for you, or where you weren't letting yourself learn the lessons you needed to.

Transit planets aspecting your natal 7th house ruler can stimulate seventh house energy as well, and conjunctions, squares, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and impact your relationships. Any existing relationship issues can worsen, and it's often a time for breakups and broken commitments if you don't work on the underlying issues (both of you).

explain.house.7.strong.title: A Strong Seventh House in Astrology
explain.house.7.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal seventh house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 7th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 7th house

- your North or South Node in your 7th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 7th house

- your 7th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 7th house or ruling the 7th house When you have a strong 7th house, this can mean your relationships are super important to you, and you're likely someone who thrives with a partner by your side (except with Saturn, then you might be on your own until later in life). Good connections are important for your sense of well-being, and you can feel great when you have a solid group of supportive loved ones.

Being better balanced, surrounding yourself with serene people instead of chaotic ones, making helpful compromises, and striving with equality can all be an important part of who you are, and maintaining yourself. You need a relatively peaceful life with supportive people, otherwise you can feel out of balance and indecisive.

explain.house.6.overview.title: All About the Sixth House in Astrology
explain.house.6.overview.text: The sixth house in astrology is focused on service and work. This is a quieter house, but can show some important aspects of your life.

explain.house.6.brief.title: 6th House Astrology: House of Work
explain.house.6.brief.text: The 6th house governs your work life and environment, and can show your approach to work and the kind of jobs you have. This house also rules your daily life, routine, and health, and your approach to them. Planets in the 6th house can impact your work life, daily life, and health. This house is naturally ruled by Mercury and connects with the sign of Virgo.
explain.house.6.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.6.natal.title: Sixth House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.6.natal.text:
Most astrology charts have 12 houses, and each rule different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and 12 houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Your natal houses each rule different parts of your life and personality.

The sixth house is naturally ruled by Mercury, the planet of the mind. While the sixth house doesn't correspond to the mind (that's the third house), it is a busy house and does relate to our daily life.

explain.house.6.keywords.title: At-a-glance Sixth House Keywords:
explain.house.6.keywords.text: work · health · service · routine and schedule · structure and order · daily life · maintenance

explain.house.6.k.work.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Work
explain.house.6.k.work.text:
The sixth house is the house of work, and is one of the professional houses (along with the second house of money and tenth house of career). The sixth house shows the work environment you need, the kind of jobs you do, and how you approach work.

This house also governs the kind of work you don't get paid for, things like tasks, chores, and personal projects.

explain.house.6.k.health.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Health
explain.house.6.k.health.text: The sixth house is also the house of health, and it can show the health ailments that plague us, as well as the approach to health we have. It can show what we need to do to be healthier, and where in our lives we can be most concerned with health and wellness.

explain.house.6.k.service.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Service
explain.house.6.k.service.text: The sixth house is one of the houses of service, along with the twelfth house. The twelfth house is service through sacrifice, while the sixth house is service through work. This is where we can do things that we don't necessarily get credit for.

explain.house.6.k.routine-and-schedule.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Routine and Schedule
explain.house.6.k.routine-and-schedule.text: The sixth house is a practical house, and rules routine and schedule. It shows the schedule we stick to, the regimen we adhere to, and where we need these things, how we approach these things, or if we stick to them at all.

explain.house.6.k.structure-and-order.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Structure and Order
explain.house.6.k.structure-and-order.text: The sixth house rules structure and order. This is a house that is organized and neat. That doesn't necessarily mean conventionally organized though, and sometimes this can look different on the outside but makes sense to the individual.

explain.house.6.k.daily-life.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Daily Life
explain.house.6.k.daily-life.text: The sixth house rules our daily lives, what we deal with on a day-to-day basis, and our approach to managing day-to-day affairs. It can show what we need to do daily.

explain.house.6.k.maintenance.title: Sixth House in Astrology: Maintenance
explain.house.6.k.maintenance.text: The sixth house rules maintenance, since this is something that is a part of routine and health. It's the maintenance of our bodies, as well as everything in our lives, from our cars to our computers to our houses and our general well being.

explain.house.6.where.title: Where Your Sixth House Energy is Found
explain.house.6.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your sixth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you work, need wellness, and crave structure. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your sixth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your sixth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 6th house energy. If you have any natal planets in your sixth house, this can make the sixth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet can strongly connect with your work, your health, and your daily life.

Transit (moving) planets touring your sixth house can bring some temporary energy for sixth house matters. It can be especially strong when it's transit Mars (bringing lots of productive energy for work), transit Saturn (demanding a lot of work from you), transit Uranus (bringing changes to your daily life), transit Pluto (transforms your work or health), or transit Chiron (focusing on healing, health, and general wellness in daily life).

Transit planets aspecting your natal 6th house ruler can stimulate sixth house energy as well, and conjunctions, square, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a lot of focus on improving your health, daily life, and connection to what you do.

explain.house.6.strong.title: A Strong Sixth House in Astrology
explain.house.6.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal sixth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 6th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 6th house

- your North or South Node in your 6th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 6th house

- your 6th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 6th house or ruling the 6th house When you have a strong 6th house, having work that you're passionate about can be very important for you, and without that, you can feel lost. You may need to also find some balance, and make your health a top priority, and manage stress in healthy ways.

Stress can be an issue for you, and you likely need to find healthy outlets and to manage frustrations better. You may put too much on yourself though, taking on too many responsibilities, and this can become overwhelming.

You may be a perfectionist, but this just adds to your stress and manages your ability to be well. You likely have to learn to go easy on yourself, and be more practical with your demands.

explain.house.10.overview.title: All About the Tenth House in Astrology
explain.house.10.overview.text: The tenth house in astrology is where we're striving. It comes after the big-thinking ninth house, where we explore what's possible, and tries to ground this energy by being practical and making plans for those big ideas. This prepares for the eleventh house, where we focus on the future and make changes.

explain.house.10.brief.title: 10th House Astrology: House of Goals
explain.house.10.brief.text: The 10th house governs your goals in life, which usually is professionally and the career you have. But this can be any goals, anything that you strive for in life. This house rules your responsibilities, status, and public image. Planets in the 10th house can impact your career and goals, your life direction, responsibilities you have, and the image you try to present. This house is naturally ruled by Saturn and connects with the sign of Capricorn.
explain.house.10.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.10.natal.title: 10th House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.10.natal.text: Astrology charts have 12 houses, and each link to different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Each of your natal houses connects to different parts of your life and personality. The 10th house is ruled by Saturn, the disciplinarian. The 10th house gets that disciplined, productive, practical energy, and it's where we have to do things the right way and for the right reasons, Saturn-style. Since it's connected to Saturn, it can also show where we bloom late.

explain.house.10.keywords.title: At-a-Glance 10th House Keywords:
explain.house.10.keywords.text: career and goals · life path and direction · disciplined · authority · maturity · ethical · responsibilities

explain.house.10.k.career-and-goals.title: 10th House in Astrology: Career and Goals
explain.house.10.k.career-and-goals.text:
The tenth house in astrology is best known as the house of career and goals. This is one of the professional houses (along with the second house = money and sixth house = work), and the tenth house often directly ties into the career you have and goals you pursue.

This is where we strive to achieve and succeed. It's where we make progress, get recognition, hit our stride, and hit new heights. The tenth house often ties to the Midheaven (or Zenith), which is the highest point in any chart.

explain.house.10.k.life-path-and-directi.title: 10th House in Astrology: Life Path and Direction
explain.house.10.k.life-path-and-directi.text:
The tenth house also rules your life path and direction. This makes sense since it rules your goals, so this ties into the path you take for success, and the direction you go in to achieve what you set out to do.

This path can be long sometimes, and windy sometimes, and it's one that goes on for all of our lives. This house can tie into later parts of our life as a result.

explain.house.10.k.disciplined.title: 10th House in Astrology: Disciplined
explain.house.10.k.disciplined.text: The tenth house connects to discipline since it's governed by Saturn. This is where we need to buckle down, get focused, and stick to our plans. We can put plans together that are thorough and detailed, and we can be smart with our actions. Our approach must be disciplined, in the way of Saturn, otherwise we may not make it. This is an area of hard work, smart work, but putting in the work for the long haul.

explain.house.10.k.authority.title: 10th House in Astrology: Authority
explain.house.10.k.authority.text:
The tenth house rules authority figures, and connects with leadership (along with the first house). The tenth house is our bosses, CEOs, judges, and the like. This can represent our bosses, but it can also show us as the boss.

How comfortable you are with being the boss and your approach to taking the lead

explain.house.10.k.maturity.title: 10th House in Astrology: Maturity
explain.house.10.k.maturity.text: The tenth house connects to maturity, and it's a house where we can take things seriously. The tenth house is the season to be practical, focused, and take a mature approach. Being governed by Saturn, the tenth house doesn't like it when we're childish or reckless. We need to be mature, and we need to grow up.

explain.house.10.k.ethical.title: 10th House in Astrology: Ethical
explain.house.10.k.ethical.text:
The tenth house connects to ethics, and it's a house where we have to do things the right way and for the right reasons (thanks to Saturn). We often don't experience the tenth house success that is possible if we don't behave ethically.

Challenging transits to the 10th house can also show failure, being exposed as a fraud, or humiliation, as a result of not following the rules. The tenth house knows the rules are there for a reason.

explain.house.10.k.responsibilities.title: 10th House in Astrology: Responsibilities
explain.house.10.k.responsibilities.text:
The tenth house rules responsibilities, and can show how much responsibility you take on, and how well you manage responsibility. With a loaded tenth house, you may be someone others naturally look to be the responsible one, and this can tie into your authority energy.

A challenged tenth house can show you struggle with responsibility, are easily overwhelmed, or have been burned too much by it. You may need to work on boundaries and give yourself more grace.

explain.house.10.where.title: Where Your Tenth House Energy is Found
explain.house.10.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your tenth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign tie into your goals and direction. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your tenth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your tenth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 10th house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your tenth house, this can make the tenth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet has a strong impact on your goals, your life path, and your responsibilities.

Transit (moving) planets touring your tenth house can bring some temporary energy for tenth house matters.
