This often directly impacts your goals, your ability to succeed or how, and making progress or taking responsibility. Transit Jupiter or Saturn in the 10th house are often the greatest periods in your life for success (you'll experience Saturn once or twice in your adult life, and Jupiter 3-4 times). Transit planets aspecting your natal 10th house ruler can stimulate tenth house energy as well, and squares and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and impact your progress. You may experience blocks, uncertainty, or outright failure. There is likely something to be learned from this.

explain.house.10.strong.title: A Strong Tenth House in Astrology
explain.house.10.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal tenth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 10th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 10th house

- your North or South Node in your 10th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 10th house

- your 10th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 10th house or ruling the 10th house When you have a strong 10th house, this can mean your goals are super important for you. You likely constantly strive for something and have a strong desire and motivation to achieve and succeed in life. You want to create something, build something, reach high places and become an impressive person.

This may come with extra responsibilities though, and you likely have to learn how to manage them. You also likely have to learn how to go easy on yourself, especially when you experience failure that is largely out of your control. You can succeed 116100% of the time, and you don't need to beat yourself up over that. Once you learn that, it can open up more pathways for you.

explain.house.3.overview.title: All About the Third House in Astrology
explain.house.3.overview.text: The third house in astrology is a house that often gets overlooked, but since it connects to the mind and the world around us, can have a surprising amount of influence.

explain.house.3.brief.title: 3rd House Astrology: House of Communications
explain.house.3.brief.text: The 3rd house governs your communication overall, showing how your mind operates, how you connect with your immediate environment and engage. This house rules your siblings, neighbors, and young people, and your younger/primary years of learning (not advanced learning). Planets in the 3rd house can impact your communication and learning abilities. This house is naturally ruled by Mercury and connects with the sign of Gemini.
explain.house.3.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.3.natal.title: Third House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.3.natal.text:
Most astrology charts have 12 houses, and each rule different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and 12 houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Your natal houses each rule different parts of your life and personality.

The third house is naturally ruled by Mercury, the planet of the mind. Mercury is a busy planet who moves fast through the Zodiac, and wants to be on its toes. Mercury doesn't like things to be stale, and finds that really boring.

explain.house.3.keywords.title: At-a-glance Third House Keywords:
explain.house.3.keywords.text: communication · immediate environment · learning · young people · variety · alike connections · active

explain.house.3.k.internal-communication.title: Third House in Astrology: Internal Communication
explain.house.3.k.internal-communication.text:
The third house is, first and foremost, a house of communication. It can show how you best use your mind, your communication style, whether you struggle with communication or not, and your outlook.

The third house is how you say what you need to say, how you converse, and how you mentally connect and open up (or don't).

This is also a social house, and how we communicate and connect in social environments can also be shown here.

explain.house.3.k.immediate-environment.title: Third House in Astrology: Immediate Environment
explain.house.3.k.immediate-environment.text:
The third house rules your immediate environment, so the environment you're in all of the time, day-to-day or regularly. It can show what that environment looks like, what you'd ideally want it to be like, and how you connect to it.

This house governs your neighborhood and community, your neighbors and community members, and how you connect with them.

explain.house.3.k.learning.title: Third House in Astrology: Learning
explain.house.3.k.learning.text: Since the third house rules communication and is ruled by Mercury, it also rules learning, but your primary learning in your younger years, not advanced learning and expertise. It can show how you are in your younger years when it comes to learning, how you learn and your approach to learning.

explain.house.3.k.young-people.title: Third House in Astrology: Young People
explain.house.3.k.young-people.text: The third house rules people younger than yourself, so it connects to the young people in your life. The exception is your children, which are ruled by the fifth house. But nieces and nephews, students, children of friends, etc. are all under the third house.

explain.house.3.k.variety.title: Third House in Astrology: Variety
explain.house.3.k.variety.text: The third house loves variety, and this house wants to keep things interesting, and variety is one of them. This house can show where we need variety, with what or how, and how we feel about variety.

explain.house.3.k.alike-connections.title: Third House in Astrology: Alike Connections
explain.house.3.k.alike-connections.text: The third house rules alike connections, so siblings, cousins, basically the familiar connections that are of your generation, your grouping, or like you. It's funny because this house does rule variety, but also these similar connections.

explain.house.3.k.active.title: Third House in Astrology: Active
explain.house.3.k.active.text: The third house is a highly active house. Since it connects to the mind, it wants business, and since it connects to variety, it wants to try lots of things. It can show how you're busy, how you're active, and what you need to be busy with.

explain.house.3.where.title: Where Your Third House Energy is Found
explain.house.3.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your third house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you communicate, keep busy, need variety, and engage. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your third house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your third house falls in) as this can also connect to the 3rd house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your third house, this can make the third house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet can strongly connect with your communication and learning styles, and where you focus your mind.

Transit (moving) planets touring your third house can bring some temporary energy for third house matters. It can be especially strong when it's transit Mars (amplifying mental energy and bringing more communications), transit Saturn (giving a negative outlook), transit Uranus (bringing brilliant insights and an unconventional approach to life), transit Pluto (makes you a more powerful communicator), or transit Chiron (focusing on healing wounds of expression or related to mental/verbal

abuse/bullying).

Transit planets aspecting your natal 3rd house ruler can stimulate third house energy as well, and conjunctions, square, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging and require a lot of focus on improving communication and expression. There's always a way out with the mind though, if you can get some control.

explain.house.3.strong.title: A Strong Third House in Astrology
explain.house.3.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal third house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 3rd house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 3rd house

- your North or South Node in your 3rd house

- your 1st house ruler in the 3rd house

- your 3rd house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 3rd house or ruling the 3rd house When you have a strong 3rd house, communication is extra important for you, and you have to learn how to be a good communicator. This means learning how to express yourself in a way that is authentic for you and healthy, while also being a strong listener.

You likely have a very active mind, bursting with ideas and always coming up with new plans, and you can get wrapped up in them. You may struggle with taking action though, depending on the condition of the house and ruler.

You can be a great conversationalist, public speaker, and student, and this talent can be useful for you throughout your life, or become a part of what you do, if you hone it well.

explain.house.12.overview.title: All About the Twelfth House in Astrology
explain.house.12.overview.text: The twelfth house in astrology is a difficult house because it governs the hidden. This is where energy goes to hide, and we have to tap into the subconscious or surrounding energies to access it.

explain.house.12.brief.title: 12th House Astrology: House of the Hidden
explain.house.12.brief.text: The 12th house governs what you hide, your subconscious mind, your spirituality, and your karma. Energy associated with the 12th house is often hidden in your subconscious, and planets in the 12th house usually manifest subconsciously, or show baggage that needs to be released. This house is naturally ruled by Neptune and connects with the sign of Pisces.
explain.house.12.brief.source: Beginner Astrology - Intro to Astrology Houses

explain.house.12.natal.title: 12th House Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.house.12.natal.text: Many astrology charts have 12 houses, and each relate to different parts of life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at. Each of your natal houses connects to different parts of your life and personality. The twelfth house is ruled by Neptune, the notorious foggy planet. Neptune obscures, and makes it difficult to see things clearly, and usually forces us to operate on instinct as a result.

explain.house.12.keywords.title: At-a-Glance 12th House Keywords:
explain.house.12.keywords.text: the hidden · karma · artistry · spiritual · sacrifice · self-undoing

explain.house.12.k.the-hidden.title: Twelfth House in Astrology: The Hidden
explain.house.12.k.the-hidden.text:
The twelfth house is the house of the hidden, so anything that is with the 12th house is hidden energy. It operates on a subconscious level, and it's something we have to work on consciously connecting with.

Twelfth house energy can come out when we're alone, when we're working behind the scenes in the background, and when we're out of the spotlight. We have to be comfortable, and we have to trust others around us, otherwise we have to be alone.

explain.house.12.k.karma.title: Twelfth House in Astrology: Karma
explain.house.12.k.karma.text: Karma is associated with the 12th house, and this can be where we have karmic lessons to learn and karmic baggage to work through. When other people connect to our 12th house, we may have a karmic connection with them.

explain.house.12.k.artistry.title: Twelfth House in Astrology: Artistry
explain.house.12.k.artistry.text:
The twelfth house is super creative, ruling the arts and imagination. This can be a way of expressing ourselves without relying on conscious thought, and we can nonverbally communicate through something artistic, creative, imaginative, and fantastically unreal.

There is a connection to energy that is outside of ourselves, and this can be difficult to control. Creativity offers a way to do that.

explain.house.12.k.spiritual.title: Twelfth House in Astrology: Spiritual
explain.house.12.k.spiritual.text:
Being ruled by Neptune, the twelfth house is a spiritual house. It governs our spiritual selves, how and where we find our spiritual beliefs, and what we connect with on a spiritual level.

This can also show a strong intuition, since we're connected to the subtle energies all around us with this house.

explain.house.12.k.sacrifice.title: Twelfth House in Astrology: Sacrifice
explain.house.12.k.sacrifice.text:
The twelfth house rules sacrifice, and what's associated with this house may show where we sacrifice in our lives. It doesn't have to be a permanent sacrifice, but it can be one that is profound and has a lasting impact on us.

We can learn through loss and gain more compassion through pain with this house, and our empathy increases, and we want to do more. Volunteer work is ruled by this house.

explain.house.12.k.self-undoing.title: Twelfth House in Astrology: Self-Undoing
explain.house.12.k.self-undoing.text:
This is the house of self-undoing, and we can be our own worst enemy with the twelfth house. It can show how and where we get in our own way, and have to learn to stop working against our own interests.

This can relate to old baggage, both in our early lives as well as karmic.

explain.house.12.where.title: Where Your Twelfth House Energy is Found
explain.house.12.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign your twelfth house falls in. The areas of life ruled by that sign are where you can find the hidden, spiritual, karmic, sacrificial energy in your life. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your twelfth house (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your twelfth house falls in) as this can also connect to the 12th house energy.

If you have any natal planets in your twelfth house, this can make the twelfth house energy a lot stronger for you. That planet is likely hidden energy to you, and you may have difficulty accessing it. You need to connect with it consciously, and not give in to sacrificing it or letting it be your undoing.

Transit (moving) planets touring your twelfth house can bring some temporary energy for twelfth house matters. It can be strongest with transit Saturn, since the lessons you need to work on and baggage you need to let go of can feel stronger. Transit planets aspecting your natal 12th house ruler can stimulate twelfth house energy as well, and conjunctions, squares, and oppositions by transit Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, or Chiron can be especially challenging, yet you may struggle with seeing things realistically and need to remove to veil clouding your vision.

explain.house.12.strong.title: A Strong Twelfth House in Astrology
explain.house.12.strong.text:
Some may have a super strong natal twelfth house. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) in the 12th house

- your Sun, Moon, or Chiron in the 12th house

- your North or South Node in your 12th house

- your 1st house ruler in the 12th house

- your 12th house cusp or ruler anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars in the 12th house or ruling the 12th house When you have a strong 12th house, you're someone who likely hides a LOT in your life. You keep everything from others, and may have many secrets. None of them may be super bad, but you're likely not comfortable sharing and are far from an open book. You have to learn to open up more.

There may be a lot of baggage you have to work on letting go of. You may struggle with issues from childhood or from past lives, and have many lessons to learn. Therapy can be a very good thing for you.

You can be super compassionate and empathetic, yet struggle to convey these things clearly. You may sacrifice yourself to help others, but it may not actually be necessary for you to do that if you just open up more.

There can be a lot in your subconscious you need to consciously connect to. Worry less about what people will think or say, and more about your own opinions of yourself.

explain.body.ceres.overview.title: All About Ceres in Astrology
explain.body.ceres.overview.text: Ceres is often called an asteroid in astrology, however it's technically a dwarf planet like Pluto. While Ceres is not considered as part of the main ten planets, I personally use Ceres like it is (one of my quirks). I think Ceres deserves way more respect!
explain.body.ceres.overview.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.natal.title: Ceres Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.ceres.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (again not including Ceres). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Ceres is argued to be the natural ruler of earth sign Taurus, sensual, grounded, and confident, and that would mean Ceres naturally connects with the second house of money. I personally still use both Venus and Ceres for Taurus.
explain.body.ceres.natal.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Ceres Keywords:
explain.body.ceres.keywords.text: nourishment · nurture · support · resources · food · quiet strength · the mother
explain.body.ceres.keywords.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.nourishment.title: Ceres in Astrology: Nourishment
explain.body.ceres.k.nourishment.text:
Ceres is the planet of nourishment in astrology. In your natal chart, your natal Ceres rules how you nourish yourself, essentially what you need to feel nourished, and where you need to be nourished in your life.

When it comes to transits, transit (moving) Ceres can bring nourishing energy to the areas of life ruled by the house in your natal chart it's touring, and you may find that you need to nourish these areas now to feel secure. Aspects by transit Ceres and to natal Ceres can impact your ability to nourish and to feel nourished.
explain.body.ceres.k.nourishment.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.nurture.title: Ceres in Astrology: Nurture
explain.body.ceres.k.nurture.text: Ceres is a nurturing planet, and wants us to feel nurtured in our lives. The sign and house placement of your natal Ceres can show how you nurture and where you channel this nurturing energy, and transits involving Ceres can show where your nurturing energy is focused at the moment and how well you're using it or not.
explain.body.ceres.k.nurture.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.support.title: Ceres in Astrology: Support
explain.body.ceres.k.support.text:
Ceres rules support, and it's what we need to feel supported and secure, as well as how we show support to others. In your natal chart, the sign and house placement of your Ceres can show how you give support and where, while the aspects can show how well you do this and any blocks.

Transits involving Ceres can impact your ability to be supportive and encouraging, and to feel supported and encouraged at the moment. Transit Ceres in the natal houses can show where you need support right now.
explain.body.ceres.k.support.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.resources.title: Ceres in Astrology: Resources
explain.body.ceres.k.resources.text:
Ceres is the planet of resources in astrology, and which includes any and all resources. This can start with physical resources, physical items you own, as well as money. It can also include mental and emotional resources you have though, and this can be shown via your natal Ceres.

Transit Ceres can impact your resources and finances, and the natal house transit Ceres tours can show where you're using resources or with what. Transit aspects to your natal Ceres can impact your ability to use what you have and have what you need.
explain.body.ceres.k.resources.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.food.title: Ceres in Astrology: Food
explain.body.ceres.k.food.text: In mythology, Ceres presided over grains and agriculture, so Ceres rules food in astrology. Your natal Ceres can show your relationship with food, your favorite foods, and your cooking ability (or lack thereof). I find Ceres transits can show when you eat a lot, overindulge, or go to the other extreme and don't eat enough, or get sick from food or with something that impacts your ability to eat.
explain.body.ceres.k.food.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.quiet-strength.title: Ceres in Astrology: Quiet Strength
explain.body.ceres.k.quiet-strength.text:
As the story goes for Ceres, her daughter was kidnapped by Hades, ruler of the Underworld (Pluto). Ceres was so distraught, that she abandoned tending to the grains, and everyone almost starved to death. The Gods struck a deal with both Hades and Ceres that her daughter would spend half the year with Hades in the Underworld (as his queen), and half the year with Ceres above ground.

Moral of the story? Don't mess with Ceres! This is a surprisingly strong body, but it may not be very obvious (like say, Mars or Pluto). It's a quieter, more subtle kind of strength, but one that becomes a great force.

On the downside, this can mean that your natal Ceres may show where you end up having to stand up against your own Hades/Pluto at some point in your life. But, know that it's also where you might be strongest and most resilient.
explain.body.ceres.k.quiet-strength.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.k.the-mother.title: Ceres in Astrology: The Mother
explain.body.ceres.k.the-mother.text:
I just mentioned the myth of Ceres involving her daughter, so Ceres also links to the mother in astrology, along with the Moon. When manifested well, Ceres can be the incredibly nurturing, supportive mother; but when not manifested well, Ceres can be too dominant and controlling. No matter what, a strong natal Ceres is often a feature in the natal charts of people who have had a strong mother influence in their lives (for better or worse).

(another reason I like adding Ceres to the major planets is Ceres is feminine, and only two of the major planets are [Moon and Venus], so Ceres gives some more of that energy)
explain.body.ceres.k.the-mother.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.where.title: Where Your Ceres Energy is Found
explain.body.ceres.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Ceres falls in. The energy of the Ceres sign is how you nurture, support, and are resourceful, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Ceres falls in are where.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Ceres can benefit from the supportive, resourceful energy of Ceres. That planet can be an area where you have plentiful resources and get lots of support in your life. On the other hand, it may also be an area where you have to fight for your rights/power/position.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Ceres can bring some temporary energy for Ceres matters. This can impact your ability to nurture and be resourceful with Ceres, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Ceres falls in.

The most challenging aspects to your natal Ceres can be hard transit Saturn (since Saturn restricts, this can restrict the resourceful, supportive energy of Ceres), and hard transit Pluto (remember Pluto is Hades so there can be a fight over power and control).
explain.body.ceres.where.subject: Ceres

explain.body.ceres.strong.title: A Strong Natal Ceres in Astrology
explain.body.ceres.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Ceres. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Ceres

- your natal Ceres conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Ceres sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Ceres

- your natal Ceres anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Ceres retrograde or conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars If your natal Ceres is in a stellium, getting support with that stellium can be more important for you to actually use it. You can also find that you're more resourceful with that stellium, and whatever it's focused on may involve using resources in smart ways. There is potential for abundance here.

Natal Ceres conjunct an angle makes it more important to nourish that area of life and maximize the resources involved with it. If conjunct your natal 1st house ruler, Ceres can seep into your personality, and you may be extra supportive of others, encouraging, and use your resources to be of help.

Ceres in your North Node sign can mean you have the potential to be extremely nurturing, and to have abundant resources in your life, but you may shy away from this initially and have blocks to work through. Ceres in your South Node sign can mean you're extra support and resourceful, but may fall back on this too much and not give yourself enough, or fight too much. Ceres with the Lunar Nodes can show "motherhood" is important as well, either you becoming a parent being important for you at some point, or your own mother/parents having unusually strong influence on you.

When your natal Ceres is anaretic, you can play up the energy too much or not at all. You can have extreme lack in your life, not get enough of what you need, and feel completely unsupported; or you can take too much, perhaps hoarding and being emotionally selfish. Middle ground is always needed with the anaretic degree, and you need to both give yourself what you need while not taking away from others' needs.

When your natal Ceres is retrograde or conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars, this can mean that you manifest Ceres in a way that is different. You likely struggle with manifesting your Ceres in your early years and feel you don't have enough (financially, physically, mentally, emotionally, spiritually). This is because you need to find another way of manifesting Ceres, and this might be different from what you would consider to be "normal"

. Once you do figure this out, you can be quite

abundant and feel secure.
explain.body.ceres.strong.subject: Ceres

explain.body.chiron.overview.title: All About Chiron in Astrology
explain.body.chiron.overview.text: Chiron is often called an asteroid in astrology, but is technically a comet (it was originally an asteroid, then a dwarf planet, and now a comet - we'll see if it changes again!). It's a slow-moving planet like Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto, so it falls in with the generational planets.
explain.body.chiron.overview.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.natal.title: Chiron Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.chiron.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

I link Chiron to earth sign Virgo, the sign of health and wellness, which would naturally connect Chiron to the sixth house of work and health.
explain.body.chiron.natal.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Chiron Keywords:
explain.body.chiron.keywords.text: wounds · healing · personal growth · personal power · intuitive · karmic · health
explain.body.chiron.keywords.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.wounds.title: Chiron in Astrology: Wounds
explain.body.chiron.k.wounds.text:
Chiron is called the Wounded Healer in astrology, so it ties into your greatest wounds in this life. In your natal chart, this is often found via the sign and house location of your natal Chiron. It can show where your greatest wound lies, or it may show an aspect of your greatest wound that festers the most.

When it comes to transits, transit (moving) Chiron has the potential to cause more wounds, often through challenging aspects (conjunctions, squares, oppositions), or to bring back out old wounds that haven't been fully addressed. This can make for great sensitivity, and we're often very vulnerable. The beneficial aspects (sextiles and trines) can make it easier to take a more objective view of our great wounds and what we need to do about them.
explain.body.chiron.k.wounds.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.healing.title: Chiron in Astrology: Healing
explain.body.chiron.k.healing.text:
I mentioned Chiron is the Wounded Healer in astrology, so it not only ties into your greatest wounds, but also how you can heal from them. How or where can be shown via the natal sign and house of your natal Chiron, and transits involving Chiron can help you with healing (sextiles and trines) or make healing harder (conjunctions, squares, and oppositions).

Some say that you never actually fully heal when it comes to Chiron, but you can heal enough that it gives you great wisdom and empathy. Many people who are healers professionally (whether spiritual types or actual medical professionals) have a strong natal Chiron as Chironic healing abilities can sometimes be more beneficial for others than for ourselves.
explain.body.chiron.k.healing.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.personal-growth.title: Chiron in Astrology: Personal Growth
explain.body.chiron.k.personal-growth.text:
As we explore our wounds, and work on healing and understanding, this naturally leads to personal growth thanks to Chiron. This is growth that ordinarily isn't attained in a chaotic way full of upheaval like with Pluto, or that comes with enormous responsibility and restrictions like with Saturn. It's quieter, and it's more personal, so it may not be fully obvious on the outside, and instead is something you feel deep within.

The personal growth we achieve with Chiron often lasts a lifetime, and helps us to be much more understanding with others and ourselves.
explain.body.chiron.k.personal-growth.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.personal-power.title: Chiron in Astrology: Personal Power
explain.body.chiron.k.personal-power.text: Along the lines of personal growth, as we heal and understand, we can also uncover more personal power. This isn't as loud as with Pluto, so again, it's quieter, but it can lead to having more confidence and feeling more secure with yourself because you recognize the innate power you have. The power you get from fighting and war is not the same as the power you get from healing and understanding. Pluto is the former while Chiron is the latter.
explain.body.chiron.k.personal-power.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.intuitive.title: Chiron in Astrology: Intuitive
explain.body.chiron.k.intuitive.text: Since Chiron is a quieter sort of body and requires a lot of introspection and reflection, it can also be highly intuitive as it's able to get a sense of the subtle energies all around us. This generally is only helpful for other people until we do some healing and growth, and then it can become helpful for ourselves as well.
explain.body.chiron.k.intuitive.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.karmic.title: Chiron in Astrology: Karmic
explain.body.chiron.k.karmic.text: Chiron can be a karmic placement, and we may feel we have spiritual and karmic baggage associated with our natal Chiron. This can mean that sometimes, the wounds we need to address aren't from this life, and are being carried over from past lives. We may need to work through it in this one to release the baggage.
explain.body.chiron.k.karmic.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.k.health.title: Chiron in Astrology: Health
explain.body.chiron.k.health.text: With Chiron ruling healing, I also find it to be a very strong body for our health in general. This can be physical health as well as mental and emotional. Your natal Chiron can show where health issues lie for you and how you can address them, while transits involving Chiron can show health issues to focus on at the moment and how to tend to them.
explain.body.chiron.k.health.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.where.title: Where Your Chiron Energy is Found
explain.body.chiron.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Chiron falls in. The energy of the Chiron sign is how you heal and what your wounds are, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Chiron falls in are where you need to heal and where your wounds may have come from. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Chiron sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Chiron falls in) as this can also connect to the Chiron energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Chiron can directly tie into your wounds, healing and growth. There can be a great wound associated with that planet, but also great healing potential and power, and the ability to achieve great growth and understanding in your life.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Chiron can bring some temporary energy for Chiron matters. This can impact your ability to heal and grow with Chiron, and bring more attention to wounds.

The most challenging aspects to your natal Chiron can be hard transit Saturn (since Saturn is the planet of lessons, there can be important lessons that need to be learned with your wounds, and you may feel quite restricted in your healing ability until you do), hard transit Uranus (who is the unexpected planet, so there can be sudden challenges with your wounds), and hard transit Pluto (the intense planet of transformation, this can create upheaval to force you to confront your wounds and has the biggest chance of wounding you again).
explain.body.chiron.where.subject: Chiron

explain.body.chiron.strong.title: A Strong Natal Chiron in Astrology
explain.body.chiron.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Chiron. This can be the case for you if you have:

- Chiron conjunct a stellium (3+ planets)

- your natal Chiron conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Chiron sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Chiron

- your natal Chiron anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Chiron conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus, Mars, or Ceres

If your natal Chiron is conjunct a stellium, this means that the stellium likely ties into your greatest wounds. Your wound may be bigger than usual, and have an impact on more areas of your life than usual. Yet your healing potential is also huge, and you can be an incredible healer once you harness that energy.

Natal Chiron conjunct an angle can mean you may have wounds to work on related to that angle, and can be more vulnerable in those areas until you grow. Chiron conjunct your 1st house ruler can make you someone who displays a lot of understanding and sensitivity, but may struggle with your own insecurities until you do more internal work.

Chiron in your North Node sign can show you have great potential to be seen as an incredible healer, someone wise and strong and empathetic, but you have to work through blocks first and do your own healing. Chiron in your South Node sign can show you may get stuck in your wounds, help others too much and ignore yourself, and are vulnerable to manipulation. You need to prioritize yourself and work on healthy boundaries.

If your natal Chiron is anaretic, this can show you play it up too much or not enough. You may shy away from healing and run from your wounds, leaving yourself vulnerable and a bit of a mess; or you may fixate on healing too much, and may end up healing everyone but yourself in the end. The anaretic degree always requires middle ground, so it's important to make sure you're healing yourself and being empathetic, but also protecting yourself and having those healthy boundaries. If your natal Chiron is conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus, Mars, or Ceres, this can show that the retrograde planet is a source of wounds and sensitivity for you, and that has to be addressed. With retrograde, you have to go about it in your own way, which can be different from what you think of as normal. Once you do find your way, there can be a lot of growth.
explain.body.chiron.strong.subject: Chiron

explain.body.jupiter.overview.title: All About Jupiter in Astrology
explain.body.jupiter.overview.text: Jupiter is a social planet in astrology along with Saturn, and these two planets connect us to our peers and show the opposite sides of the coin in our lives: expansion (Jupiter) and limitations (Saturn). Jupiter is a benefic, meaning it's one of the beneficial planets (along with Venus).
explain.body.jupiter.overview.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.natal.title: Jupiter Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.jupiter.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Jupiter is the natural ruling planet for fire sign Sagittarius, the sign of optimism and adventure, and naturally connects to the ninth house, the house of higher education, long-distance travel, and beliefs.
explain.body.jupiter.natal.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Jupiter Keywords:
explain.body.jupiter.keywords.text: expansion · opportunity · luck · optimism · bold · space · beliefs
explain.body.jupiter.keywords.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.expansion.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Expansion
explain.body.jupiter.k.expansion.text:
In your natal chart, your natal Jupiter rules what you expand and how you expand. Jupiter's base energy is expansion, first and foremost, and the sign your natal Jupiter is in can show how you expand while the house your natal Jupiter is in can show where you need to expand in your life. These are the areas of life where you must expand, otherwise you feel suffocated.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Jupiter can impact your ability to expand and what you may expand. Conjunctions (alignments) can show you want to expand with whatever that transit planet or body rules, and hard aspects (squares and oppositions) can make it harder to expand, while beneficial aspects (sextiles and trines) can make it easier.
explain.body.jupiter.k.expansion.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.opportunity.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Opportunity
explain.body.jupiter.k.opportunity.text: Jupiter is the ruler of opportunities. This is linked to Jupiter being the planet of expansion. Opportunities come along to help us expand and explore, and Jupiter wants us to take them. We may end up having extra opportunities in the areas of life ruled by the house natal Jupiter resides, or that come to us in ways ruled by the sign natal Jupiter falls in.
explain.body.jupiter.k.opportunity.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.luck.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Luck
explain.body.jupiter.k.luck.text: Jupiter is the planet of luck in astrology. Remember that Jupiter is a beneficial planet, and doesn't want to bring anything bad to our lives. Jupiter wants us to take advantage of luck that's presented to us, and to make our own luck by taking chances on ourselves. We just have to be mindful of pushing our luck, since that can lead to issues.
explain.body.jupiter.k.luck.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.optimism.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Optimism
explain.body.jupiter.k.optimism.text: Jupiter is an optimistic planet, only wanting to see the good. It doesn't care much for anything serious, mundane, practical, or dark, and wants lightness at all times. Jupiter is the big picture and big ideas that we can take advantage of, and this helps with being optimistic because it can see how everything fits together. The downside is, this can sometimes lead to laziness and lacking motivation, because we feel so good that we don't feel the drive to take action. That leads to missing out on beneficial Jupiter. This is what has to be fought with the hard aspects in the natal chart and in transits.
explain.body.jupiter.k.optimism.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.bold.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Bold
explain.body.jupiter.k.bold.text: Jupiter is bold, daring, wants to take a chance and get out and go. Jupiter isn't quiet and doesn't take a back seat. Jupiter wants us to take a chance, since this can lead to expansion in our lives and the creation of luck.
explain.body.jupiter.k.bold.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.space.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Space
explain.body.jupiter.k.space.text: Since Jupiter is the planet of expansion, it also rules space. Your natal Jupoter sign can show how you get space, while your natal Jupiter house can show where you need space. These are the areas where we can push to do things our own way, and where we may have a tendency to run away, so we do have to control that.
explain.body.jupiter.k.space.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.k.beliefs.title: Jupiter in Astrology: Beliefs
explain.body.jupiter.k.beliefs.text: Jupiter in astrology rules our beliefs, and these can be religious and political. This links Jupiter to Venus-Ceres (ruling values) and Neptune (ruling spirituality). Jupiter can show what we believe in and can stand up for and defend, and we can be passionate about this.
explain.body.jupiter.k.beliefs.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.where.title: Where Your Jupiter Energy is Found
explain.body.jupiter.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Jupiter falls in. The energy of the Jupiter sign is how you expand, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Jupiter falls in are where you need space. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Jupiter sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Jupiter falls in) as this can also connect to the Jupiter energy. Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Jupiter benefit from Jupiter's lucky, expansive energy, and whatever that planet or body rules, Jupiter expands on and can make luck for you. Things may just have a habit of working out no matter what with the planet/body.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Jupiter can bring some temporary energy for the Jupiter matters. This can impact your ability to expand and pursue opportunities with Jupiter, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Jupiter falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Jupiter rules (so the house that falls in Sagittarius).

The most challenging aspects to your natal Jupiter can be hard transit Saturn (since Saturn restricts, this can restrict the expansive energy of Jupiter). But, there honestly aren't any really terrible aspects to your natal Jupiter because it's such an optimistic, beneficial planet. Even hard Saturn can be used in super productive ways that benefit you.
explain.body.jupiter.where.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.jupiter.strong.title: A Strong Natal Jupiter in Astrology
explain.body.jupiter.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Jupiter. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Jupiter

- your natal Jupiter conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Jupiter sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Jupiter

- your natal Jupiter anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Jupiter as a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type) If your natal Jupiter is in a stellium, it'll actually enhance the stellium's impact on you, making it stronger thanks to Jupiter's expansive energy. The other planets involved get a big boost by Jupiter, and Jupiter can make the stellium a bit lucky for you. Natal Jupiter conjunct an angle can amplify the impact of that angle on your life, and that part of your life can get extra attention and be more important for your happiness. If conjunct your Ascendant or your 1st house ruler, this brings Jupiter's energy to your personality, and you can seem fairly Sagittarius (optimistic, gregarious, adventurous, fun). Jupiter in your North Node sign is a lucky position, and you may naturally fall into your potential and purpose with greater ease than most; while Jupiter in your South Node sign can show you may fall to your bad habits a little too much, however you can utilize your strengths with greater ease, and once you put in effort, can release your bad habits.

Your natal Jupiter can be extra elevated if it's anaretic or a singleton. Both of these greatly amplify your natal Jupiter energy, but it can go either way. You may run away from it and end up restricting yourself, never taking chances, and holding yourself back; or you may go too far, take risks that are foolhardy, and constantly mess things up. You need to find middle ground here, and be smart with your expansive energy, with what you choose to pursue, and with the opportunities you take advantage of. If you can exercise some discipline and make use of your smarts, you can create all of your own luck whenever you want.
explain.body.jupiter.strong.subject: Jupiter

explain.body.mars.overview.title: All About Mars in Astrology
explain.body.mars.overview.text: Mars in astrology is one of the personal planets, along with Venus and Mercury. This means we feel these planets in a personal way, and Mars is what drives you to take action and how action is taken.
explain.body.mars.overview.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.natal.title: Mars Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.mars.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Mars is the natural ruling planet of fire sign Aries, who is the first sign and links to beginnings and the start of everything, and naturally links to the first house, where it all starts with the houses.
explain.body.mars.natal.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Mars Keywords:
explain.body.mars.keywords.text: energy, drive & motivation · gut instincts · taking initiative · pioneering · leader · aggressive · positive
explain.body.mars.keywords.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.energy-drive-and-mot.title: Mars in Astrology: Energy, Drive and Motivation
explain.body.mars.k.energy-drive-and-mot.text:
In your natal chart, your natal Mars rules your energy and drive. It shows how you take action, with what you take action, and what drives you to take action. This is mostly found via your Mars sign, and the house in your natal chart natal Mars falls in can show where you take action, with what you're most driven to pursue and act. Conjunctions (alignments by other planets to your Mars) can have a direct impact on your energy, and you can be extra driven to take action with whatever the planet rules. The Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Venus can be overtaken by Mars though, while Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto might try to overtake Mars.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Mars can impact your energy and drive. The beneficial aspects can push you to act, and you can be extra driven and focused on making things happen. But the hard aspects can bring out frustration, and impulse can get you in trouble.
explain.body.mars.k.energy-drive-and-mot.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.gut-instincts.title: Mars in Astrology: Gut Instincts
explain.body.mars.k.gut-instincts.text: Mars is a planet that doesn't want to sit around and wait. It can jump to action quickly. It's helped by great gut instincts, those first instincts and impressions that immediately hit you. This allows Mars to be confident in the actions it takes, though it can also rely on it too much instead of thinking things through a little bit.
explain.body.mars.k.gut-instincts.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.taking-initiative.title: Mars in Astrology: Taking Initiative
explain.body.mars.k.taking-initiative.text: Mars in astrology is the one who takes the initiative. It has no problem going for what it wants without waiting for permission or for someone else to lead the way. It can create its own opportunities, and it can take the initiative for anything it wants, utilizing its energy and drive.
explain.body.mars.k.taking-initiative.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.pioneering.title: Mars in Astrology: Pioneering
explain.body.mars.k.pioneering.text: Mars rules the very first Zodiac sign, and connects to the first house. Mars has no problem going down paths no one else has before, blazing new trails, and being the pioneer. It's enthusiastic about this, and excited by the new that awaits it.
explain.body.mars.k.pioneering.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.leader.title: Mars in Astrology: Leader
explain.body.mars.k.leader.text: Mars is one of the leaders in astrology, and can be enthusiastic about taking the lead. It doesn't want to be led by others, and doesn't do well being bossed around. Mars doesn't care too much about being the boss either though, and is more of a lead-by-example type, and is super independent so it wants to go its own way.
explain.body.mars.k.leader.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.aggressive.title: Mars in Astrology: Aggressive
explain.body.mars.k.aggressive.text:
Mars in astrology can get aggressive when it's not operating well. There is so much energy and drive and enthusiasm that this can turn into impatience, impulsive behavior, frustration, and aggravation, which can make Mars aggressive. Mars is also one of the rulers of war, and can lead to violence.

Transit (moving) planets making hard aspects to your natal Mars can bring out major frustration and aggression. Same with hard transit aspects by transit Mars to any of your natal bodies, and it'll be focused on whatever those bodies rule. The house in your natal chart transit Mars is touring can get this aggressive energy as well. The areas of life the house rules can get major energy, and if you don't use this well, or it's accompanied by hard Mars aspects, this can tick you off and make it easy to blow up.
explain.body.mars.k.aggressive.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.k.positive.title: Mars in Astrology: Positive
explain.body.mars.k.positive.text: Mars in astrology is a positive planet. It doesn't want to focus on the negatives very much, and wants to enjoy itself. Mars is enthusiastic and excited, so it tends to stay positive.
explain.body.mars.k.positive.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.where.title: Where Your Mars Energy is Found
explain.body.mars.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Mars falls in. The energy of the Mars sign is how you take action, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Mars falls in are where you take action. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Mars sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Mars falls in) as this can also connect to the Mars energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Mars can impact your ability to take action and take the lead. Mars is a strong planet, so it can dominate some planets in a conjunction like the Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Venus, so Mars can inject a ton of energy and drive into anything it conjuncts.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Mars can bring some temporary energy for Mars matters. This can impact your energy and drive with Mars, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Mars falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Mars rules (so the house that falls in Aries). The most challenging aspects to your natal Mars can be hard transit Pluto (this can bring intense power struggles and anger that explodes if there's any suppression), and hard transit Saturn (since Saturn restricts and can make energy difficult to find; Saturn also teaches so if you don't use energy well, Saturn can punish you for that to try and teach you a lesson).
explain.body.mars.where.subject: Mars

explain.body.mars.strong.title: A Strong Natal Mars in Astrology
explain.body.mars.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Mars. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Mars

- your natal Mars conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Mars sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Mars

- your natal Mars anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Mar retrograde

- retrograde Venus or Mercury conjunct your natal Mars

If your natal Mars is in a stellium, this can make taking the initiative and pursuing something an important part of that stellium, and you need to have something to channel the energy into productively. If your natal Mars is conjunct a retrograde Venus or Mercury, or is retrograde itself, you likely have an alternative way of taking action and taking the initiative. This might not look like much on the surface, and you may seem like someone who can be pushed over easily until you learn your own strength and find your way of asserting yourself.

An anaretic natal Mars can show you either are a super leader who must take the lead with everything and won't wait for anyone, or you take a back seat to everyone else and refuse to take the lead at any point. You need to learn to be comfortable with your leadership skills while also being considerate of others.

Mars conjunct an angle gives plenty of energy and drive for that angle; conjunct your North Node, you can connect take the initiative for what you want with enthusiasm and excitement; conjunct the South Node, you may take the lead too much, ignoring others or acting impulsively and putting yourself in a bad position; and conjunct the 1st house ruler, you can come across as energized and enthusiastic.
explain.body.mars.strong.subject: Mars

explain.body.mercury.overview.title: All About Mercury in Astrology
explain.body.mercury.overview.text: Mercury in astrology is one of the personal planets, along with Venus and Mars. This means we feel these planets in a personal way, and Mercury connects to your minds and ability to express ourselves.
explain.body.mercury.overview.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.natal.title: Mercury Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.mercury.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Mercury is the natural ruling planets for two signs, airy Gemini who rules the mind, and earthy Virgo who rules the details, and naturally connects with two houses, the third house of education and the sixth house of work.
explain.body.mercury.natal.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Mercury Keywords:
explain.body.mercury.keywords.text: the mind · active · variety · immediate environment · thoughts and ideas · news · duality
explain.body.mercury.keywords.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.the-mind.title: Mercury in Astrology: The Mind
explain.body.mercury.k.the-mind.text:
In your natal chart, your natal Mercury rules your mind. It shows how you express yourself, your communication style, as well as how you learn and share knowledge or information. This is mostly found via your Mercury sign, and the house in your natal chart natal Mercury falls in can show areas where you communicate a lot more, need to express yourself, or have a lot of knowledge.

Conjunctions (alignments by other planets to your Mercury) tend to be strong, and can dominate your communication style and knowledge. But, you also feel the other major aspects the planets make to your natal Mercury, and they can show how you connect with them mentally.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Mercury can be felt mentally. They can impact your ability to express yourself openly and authentically, and impact your connection to your mind.
explain.body.mercury.k.the-mind.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.active.title: Mercury in Astrology: Active
explain.body.mercury.k.active.text:
Mercury is a fast-moving planet, second only to the Moon, and Mercury likes to be quick on its feet and ready to move. This means Mercury is a planet that is quite active, and wants to have plenty to do.

We tend to keep busy with our Mercury and whatever it rules, and we generally don't want to sit around and wait for very long. We can feel that staying busy helps more.
explain.body.mercury.k.active.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.variety.title: Mercury in Astrology: Variety
explain.body.mercury.k.variety.text: Mercury in astrology loves variety. This is because it connects to the mind and it wants to be active, so variety helps with giving plenty to focus on to keep it interesting. Whatever Mercury is doing, we usually want some variety with it.
explain.body.mercury.k.variety.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.immediate-environ.title: Mercury in Astrology: Immediate Environment
explain.body.mercury.k.immediate-environ.text:
Mercury in astrology is an active planet, but it's one that doesn't go far into the future, so it governs our immediate environment. It's local, it's what's around us. It's siblings, neighbors, communities, schools.

We tend to want to build community with our Mercury and whatever it rules, and we generally don't want to disconnect much.
explain.body.mercury.k.immediate-environ.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.thoughts-and-idea.title: Mercury in Astrology: Thoughts and Ideas
explain.body.mercury.k.thoughts-and-idea.text:
Transit (moving) Mercury brings mental focus to whatever it's touching. We tend to think a lot about the areas of life ruled by the natal house transit Mercury is touring and the planets being aspected by transit Mercury.

We can come up with lots of new ideas as well, especially under conjunctions. Mental energy can be easy to use with sextiles and trines, and focus might be a challenge with squares and oppositions.
explain.body.mercury.k.thoughts-and-idea.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.news.title: Mercury in Astrology: News
explain.body.mercury.k.news.text:
Mercury in astrology governs communication, thoughts, and ideas, so it also governs news. Our natal Mercury may show how we get news and what do we get most news about, and how we give news.

Transits with transit Mercury to the natal bodies or by transit planets to natal Mercury can stimulate energy for news, and important news can be shared by you or with you at the time it occurs.
explain.body.mercury.k.news.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.k.duality.title: Mercury in Astrology: Duality
explain.body.mercury.k.duality.text:
Mercury in astrology is dual in nature. It rules two Zodiac signs and two houses, and it's seen as a planet that can flip around. Remember that it's an active planet that loves variety, so it makes sense to be dual in nature.

This means Mercury can connect with two of whatever it's doing. Mercury in the professional houses (2nd, 6th, 10th) can show having two jobs or careers; Mercury in the relationship houses (5th, 7th) can show two great loves/relationships; Mercury in the 11th house of friends can show two best friends at a time, and on and on.
explain.body.mercury.k.duality.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.where.title: Where Your Mercury Energy is Found
explain.body.mercury.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Mercury falls in. The energy of the Mercury sign is how you communicate and use your mind, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Mercury falls in are where you need to communicate and express yourself. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Mercury sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Mercury falls in) as this can also connect to the Mercury energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Mercury can be super important and have a direct impact on your communication style and mode of thinking. They might be more dominant than the sign Mercury is in.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Mercury can bring some temporary energy for the Mercury matters. This can impact you mentally with Mercury, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Mercury falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the houses your Mercury rules (so the houses that fall in Gemini and Virgo).

The most challenging aspects to your natal Mercury can be hard transit Pluto (since Pluto wants to wreck your mind, and you have to work to transform and empower your mind), hard transit Saturn (since Saturn restricts and can bring a more depressive mood), and hard transit Neptune (since Neptune obscures and can make it difficult to see reality).
explain.body.mercury.where.subject: Mercury

explain.body.mercury.strong.title: A Strong Natal Mercury in Astrology
explain.body.mercury.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Mercury. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Mercury

- your natal Mercury conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Mercury sign

58- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Mercury

- your natal Mercury anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Mercury retrograde

- retrograde Venus or Mars conjunct your natal Mercury

If your natal Mercury is in a stellium, this can make your mind an important part of that stellium, and you need to make sure you're communicating and expressing yourself well. If your natal Mercury is conjunct a retrograde Venus or Mars, or is retrograde itself, you likely have an alternative way of communicating and using your mind, and this may be perceived as you being stupid or having a disability when young (even when you don't). There is power in this position but it usually comes after tearing down your self-esteem when it comes to your mind.

An anaretic natal Mercury can show you either are a super communicator and can't shut up, or you never speak up about anything and have no confidence in your ability to do so. That's the nature of the anaretic degree, and you need to find middle ground. Having confidence in your ideas and mental abilities, but also be a good listener and receptive to others.

Mercury conjunct an angle makes communication and your mind more important for that angle; conjunct your North Node, you can connect with your potentially mentally and realize your potential via your ideas; conjunct the South Node, you may fall back on bad habits mentally, and have to work on taking control of your mental abilities; and conjunct the 1st house ruler, you can be more expressive and comfortable with sharing your ideas.
explain.body.mercury.strong.subject: Mercury

explain.body.neptune.overview.title: All About Neptune in Astrology
explain.body.neptune.overview.text: Neptune in astrology is one of the generational outer planets, along with Uranus and Pluto. These planets spend a long time in one Zodiac sign, so entire generations often have them in the same sign. Neptune is our spiritual selves, and connects to the subtle energies all around us.
explain.body.neptune.overview.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.natal.title: Neptune Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.neptune.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Neptune is the natural ruling planet for water sign Pisces, the most fluid and flexible of the signs, and naturally connects with the twelfth house, the house of endings and the hidden.
explain.body.neptune.natal.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Neptune Keywords:
explain.body.neptune.keywords.text: spirituality · intuition · imagination and the arts · compassion and empathy · sacrifice · dissolving · obscuring
explain.body.neptune.keywords.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.spirituality.title: Neptune in Astrology: Spirituality
explain.body.neptune.k.spirituality.text:
In your natal chart, your natal Neptune rules your spiritual self. It can show how you connect to your spiritual self, your spirituality and spiritual beliefs, and your connection to the beyond.

Conjunctions (alignments by other planets to your Neptune) tend to be strong, though the other planet can take over Neptune at times, while Neptune can hide the planet it's conjunct. There is often some trauma or baggage associated with the conjunct planet, and dealing with that is important.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Neptune can impact your connection to your spiritual self, either strengthening this connection with sextiles and trines, or challenging it with squares and oppositions.
explain.body.neptune.k.spirituality.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.intuition.title: Neptune in Astrology: Intuition
explain.body.neptune.k.intuition.text: Neptune governs our intuition, and can show where you use and benefit from your intuition with the house in your natal chart it's located both natally and in transit. This is where you have to strengthen your connection to your intuition, and where you can get intuitive insights.
explain.body.neptune.k.intuition.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.imagination-and-t.title: Neptune in Astrology: Imagination and the Arts
explain.body.neptune.k.imagination-and-t.text: Neptune in astrology rules imagination and the arts, specifically art itself and music, though imagination can also link to writing. Neptune rules fantasy, what's not of this world, and this lends itself to creative inspiration, and creativity can often be the only way to express what is felt with Neptune. Creativity can also bypass the need for conscious or thought-out expression, which can be difficult sometimes, and with Neptune being foggy, not having to be practical and focused is a big help.
explain.body.neptune.k.imagination-and-t.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.compassion-and-em.title: Neptune in Astrology: Compassion and Empathy
explain.body.neptune.k.compassion-and-em.text: Neptune in astrology rules compassion and empathy. Thanks to the strong imagination, Neptune helps us envision what it's like for others, to put ourselves in others' shoes, without having to actually experience it ourselves. This gives us empathy, and that makes us more compassionate and understanding.
explain.body.neptune.k.compassion-and-em.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.sacrifice.title: Neptune in Astrology: Sacrifice
explain.body.neptune.k.sacrifice.text:
Neptune in astrology rules sacrifice. Neptune wants to be of service, but not in a broad way like Uranus. Neptune wants to be of service in a deeply personal, one-on-one kind of way, and thanks to the supreme compassion and empathy, is willing to make sacrifices to help.

This part of Neptune is where needing healthy boundaries is very important, because with Neptune, it's easy to be taken advantage of. We want to help so much, and the manipulative among us can take-take-take if we're not careful.
explain.body.neptune.k.sacrifice.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.dissolving.title: Neptune in Astrology: Dissolving
explain.body.neptune.k.dissolving.text:
Transit Neptune's base energy is to dissolve. This often means that it takes away something from whatever natl planet it's touching with a conjunction, square, or opposition. This isn't usually traumatic though; in fact, we often don't even realize it until the transit is over. Neptune causes it to fade out of existence rather than be something big and loud like Uranus or Pluto.

Sextiles and trines by transit Neptune can still dissolve something, however we can be more aware of this, and see it as a good thing, or are the ones who are making it go away.
explain.body.neptune.k.dissolving.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.k.obscuring.title: Neptune in Astrology: Obscuring
explain.body.neptune.k.obscuring.text:
Neptune is known as the foggy planet. It has obscuring energy, and can hide whatever it's in contact with. In your natal chart, the house natal Neptune is located can get this energy, and you may not see everything there is to see, and have to work at being more grounded. This can also be the case with any natal planet Neptune is conjunct, square, or opposite.

Transit Neptune can also obscure, temporarily with the areas of life ruled by the house it's touring in your natal chart, and with the natal planets it's conjunct, square, or opposite. This is hidden from you, and you may not realize what's been out of your view until Neptune has moved on.
explain.body.neptune.k.obscuring.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.where.title: Where Your Neptune Energy is Found
explain.body.neptune.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Neptune falls in. The energy of the Neptune sign is how you connect to your spiritual self, intuition, imagination, and compassionate side, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Neptune falls in are where you need to operate on intuition and be creative. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Neptune sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Neptune falls in) as this can also connect to the Neptune energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Neptune can be super important with your spiritual self, and can show where you need to be intuitive. But, they can also be obscured by Neptune, and you have difficulty seeing them consciously. They can be sources of major creativity and artistic talent though.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Neptune can bring some temporary energy for the Neptune matters. This can impact you spiritually with Neptune, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Neptune falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Neptune rules (so the house that falls in Pisces).

The most challenging aspects to your natal Neptune can be hard transit Saturn (since Saturn is realistic and gets annoyed by the imaginative intuitive nature of Neptune), and hard transit Chiron (since Chiron rules our wounds and Neptune can struggle with boundaries so we can be wounded easily).
explain.body.neptune.where.subject: Neptune

explain.body.neptune.strong.title: A Strong Natal Neptune in Astrology
explain.body.neptune.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Neptune. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Neptune

- your natal Neptune conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Neptune sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct natal Neptune

- your natal Neptune anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus or Mars conjunct your natal Neptune

If your natal Neptune is in a stellium, it can either make your natal Neptune disappear so it gets overtaken by the other planets in the stellium, or it can make it so Neptune obscures the stellium and you have a hard time accessing the energy consciously. You likely need to connect to it subconsciously, and have a block to work through. But it can be a source of great ability and power once you do. If your natal Neptune is conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus or Mars, you likely have an alternative way of connecting to your spiritual self, your intuition, your imagination, and your compassion. There can be a big block or old trauma associated with this though, and that has to be worked through first before you can find that alternate way.

An anaretic natal Neptune can show you either are way too much into your Neptune and get lost in fantasy, can't handle reality, and are super easily manipulated and taken advantage of, or you shy away from your Neptune completely and have difficulty connecting to your intuition, spirituality, and imagination at all. Balance, moderation, but also working through issues and blocks are needed.

Neptune conjunct an angle makes a spiritual connection, imagination, and strong intuition more important for that angle; conjunct your North Node, you can have great potential with your spirituality, intuition, and imagination, but need to get through fear of this first; conjunct the South Node, you may have a deeply spiritual side, but can use it as a crutch to avoid reality and have to learn to deal with the physical world; and conjunct the 1st house ruler, you can be super charismatic and empathetic, but have to keep healthy boundaries in mind.
explain.body.neptune.strong.subject: Neptune

explain.body.pluto.overview.title: All About Pluto in Astrology
explain.body.pluto.overview.text: Pluto is one of the outer planets. pr generational planets, along with Uranus and Neptune. They are called generational planets because they spend so long in one Zodiac sign, that most or all of a generation can have them in the same sign. This is especially true for Pluto, who spends 15-20 years in each sign, and is the slowest planet.
explain.body.pluto.overview.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.natal.title: Pluto Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.pluto.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Pluto is the natural ruling planet for water sign Scorpio, the intense and passionate sign, and naturally connects to the eighth house, the house of other people's money (money that involves other people) and transformation.
explain.body.pluto.natal.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Pluto Keywords:
explain.body.pluto.keywords.text: transformation · research and investigation · darkness · depth · fear · power and control · passion and intensity · taboo · the witch
explain.body.pluto.keywords.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.transformation.title: Pluto in Astrology: Transformation
explain.body.pluto.k.transformation.text:
At its core, Pluto is the planet of transformation. In your natal chart, your natal Pluto can show how and where you have to transform in your life. This can be a big transformation at some point, or it might be many smaller ones throughout your life. This is largely focused on the areas of life ruled by the house your natal Pluto is in, and aspects it makes (especially conjunctions).

When it comes to transits, transit (moving) Pluto can make it important to transform with whatever planet or body it's aspecting. Sextiles and trines can make it easy for you and a positive experience, while conjunct, squares, and oppositions can make it super challenging and force you to confront things you'd rather keep running from.
explain.body.pluto.k.transformation.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.research-and-invest.title: Pluto in Astrology: Research and Investigation
explain.body.pluto.k.research-and-invest.text: Pluto doesn't like anything superficial, so it's willing to dig deeper. It wants to get to the heart of matters, and this makes it an intense sign for research and investigation. Pluto can keep digging until it gets to the core and finds everything it needs to find. Because of this Pluto also rules solutions (as we take the information we find and come up with solutions to problems), and is one of the science rulers (along with Uranus).
explain.body.pluto.k.research-and-invest.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.darkness.title: Pluto in Astrology: Darkness
explain.body.pluto.k.darkness.text: Pluto governs the dark side in astrology. Pluto is Hades, ruler of the Underworld/Hell, so Pluto can connect with the darkness within us. Everyone has a dark side, and Pluto relishes living in that part of ourselves. Getting some control over it can be important though.
explain.body.pluto.k.darkness.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.depth.title: Pluto in Astrology: Depth
explain.body.pluto.k.depth.text:
Since Pluto wants to get to the heart of matters, is researching and investigative and hates superficiality, Pluto governs our depths. Pluto is what we hide way down deep inside of us, what we shove away for another day, only to ignore it forever. We run from this, we hide from this, we keep putting it way down deep.

Pluto wants depth, but it will punish us eventually for running from what is there. We need to be willing to venture into the depths and face what's there.
explain.body.pluto.k.depth.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.fear.title: Pluto in Astrology: Fear
explain.body.pluto.k.fear.text: Pluto rules our fears, what we're terrified of. This can be internal or external, but we tend to run from this. Pluto demands that we stop running and avoiding, and face our fears directly. Pluto challenges us and tries to force us to face our greatest fears. Whether or not we learn from them is up to us.
explain.body.pluto.k.fear.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.power-and-control.title: Pluto in Astrology: Power and Control
explain.body.pluto.k.power-and-control.text:
Pluto rules power and control, and shows how we can empower ourselves, where we can find power, how we take control, and where we need to take control. This can be flipped sometimes though, and show how others have power and control over us.

Natal Pluto can show where you may have power and control issues that need to be worked on. A transformation is usually needed.
explain.body.pluto.k.power-and-control.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.passion-and-intensi.title: Pluto in Astrology: Passion and Intensity
explain.body.pluto.k.passion-and-intensi.text: Pluto is a passionate and intense planet in astrology. Pluto doesn't do anything halfway. Pluto is either all in or all out, and there's no real middle ground there. When Pluto cares, it cares hard and fully; and when Pluto doesn't care, it's like you don't exist.
explain.body.pluto.k.passion-and-intensi.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.taboo.title: Pluto in Astrology: Taboo
explain.body.pluto.k.taboo.text: Pluto rules the taboo in astrology. What's forbidden can be enticing to Pluto, and it wants to venture into territories that are off-limits. Pluto doesn't accept that, and wants to explore and understand, and knows you can't do that if you ignore it. Pluto gets a kind of thrill from the taboo, so there is a bit of a rebellious side to it (though Uranus rules rebellion, but when the two of them get together, it's quite the wow!).
explain.body.pluto.k.taboo.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.k.the-witch.title: Pluto in Astrology: The Witch
explain.body.pluto.k.the-witch.text: I know, Pluto is one of the science rulers but it's also ruler of the witch! Haha, well it ties into many aspects of Pluto, like the taboo, as science has been seen throughout history as a threatening subject to many, as has the witch. Both science and the witch also tie into the darkness and depth of Pluto, and can give power and control to whoever wields them.
explain.body.pluto.k.the-witch.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.where.title: Where Your Pluto Energy is Found
explain.body.pluto.where.text:
