For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Pluto falls in. The energy of the Pluto sign is how you transform, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Pluto falls in are where you transform. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Pluto sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Pluto falls in) as this can also connect to the Pluto energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Pluto can get overtaken by Pluto's intensity. Whatever the planet rules, Pluto can make it extremely strong and powerful, but too much at times, and you may have such intense energy associated with it that it is difficult to control. You can encounter many power struggles and control issues with it. A major transformation is often needed, or many smaller transformations throughout your life, with whatever it rules.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Pluto can bring some temporary energy for Pluto matters. This can impact your ability to transform and research with Pluto as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Pluto rules (so the house that falls in Scorpio).

The most challenging aspects to your natal Pluto can be hard transit Uranus (who rules change, the sudden and unexpected, so paired with transformative Pluto, this can lead to massive changes and unexpected developments you need to be quick to work with), hard transit Chiron (the wounded healer, this can bring out deep wounds from the past), and hard transit Pluto (most only live long enough to experience the square in their late 30's, but if you do the work to transform ahead of time, it can be an empowering period; if you don't it can be a defeating one).
explain.body.pluto.where.subject: Pluto

explain.body.pluto.strong.title: A Strong Natal Pluto in Astrology
explain.body.pluto.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Pluto. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Pluto

- your natal Pluto conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Pluto sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Pluto

- your natal Pluto anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Pluto as a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type) If your natal Pluto is in a stellium, it might take that stellium over, especially if the other planets are the faster ones (Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars) or Jupiter or Neptune. That can make the stellium incredibly intense, and you may encounter issues when you manifest it and have to hold your ground. Pretty much only Saturn and Uranus can go up against Pluto. If Saturn is in the stellium, it may try to control Pluto, but the two likely fight and you sway from super controlled to super out of control. If Uranus is in the stellium, there can be lots of sudden developments leading to unexpected power/control issues.

Natal Pluto conjunct an angle can bring the intensity of Pluto to whatever that angle rules, and you may experience more power struggles and control issues. It becomes important for you to transform and empower yourself, otherwise you may be at the mercy of manipulative others. If Pluto is conjunct your 1st house ruler, Pluto can infuse your personality, and you may seem more dominating and intense. Pluto in your North Node sign means you need to embrace your power and take control, be strong and willful, but you may shy away from this, scared of it, and need to work on pushing through the fear. Pluto in your South Node sign means you may fall back to your intensity and passion and dominating side too much, and need to learn better balance, compromise, and consideration.

Your natal Pluto can be extra elevated if it's anaretic or a singleton. Both of these greatly amplify your natal Pluto energy, but it can go either way. If you run away from it, you may be a pushover, and find you're constantly around others who control you and have ill intentions. If you go too far with it, you may be the one acting that way and controlling others. Middle ground is very important here, and you need to embrace your own power while showing others the respect to embrace their own.
explain.body.pluto.strong.subject: Pluto

explain.body.saturn.overview.title: All About Saturn in Astrology
explain.body.saturn.overview.text: Saturn is one of the social planets in astrology, along with Jupiter, and these two planets can show how we're alike our peers. While Jupiter is the planet of expansion, Saturn is the planet of restriction, and is one of the hard planets in astrology.
explain.body.saturn.overview.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.natal.title: Saturn Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.saturn.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Saturn is the natural ruling planet for earth sign Capricorn, sign of goals, and naturally connects to the tenth house, the house of goals, life path, and direction.
explain.body.saturn.natal.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Saturn Keywords:
explain.body.saturn.keywords.text: lessons · limitations · responsibility · maturity · authority · ethics · discipline
explain.body.saturn.keywords.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.lessons.title: Saturn in Astrology: Lessons
explain.body.saturn.k.lessons.text:
In your natal chart, Saturn is the planet of lessons. These are the biggest life lessons you have to learn, and you absolutely have to learn them. If you don't, Saturn will punish you, and Saturn's punishments can be absolutely brutal (only Pluto compares). Your Saturn lessons are found in the sign and house location of your natal Saturn, and these are the areas where you must learn.

Transit (moving) Saturn conjuncts (aligns with) your natal Saturn for the first time in your late 20's or early 30's, and this is known as the first Saturn Return. Usually, this is when we're forced to confront our Saturn lessons. If we do learn them, we can grow, mature, and life gets easier as a reward. If we keep avoiding them, we can keep getting punished by Saturn, pushed down and down, and continue to struggle in life.
explain.body.saturn.k.lessons.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.limitations.title: Saturn in Astrology: Limitations
explain.body.saturn.k.limitations.text: Saturn's base energy in astrology is restriction. Saturn limits our options. This gets us to get focused, and to learn to work with what we have instead of lamenting what we don't. Saturn is always trying to get us to learn (as annoying as it can be sometimes).
explain.body.saturn.k.limitations.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.responsibility.title: Saturn in Astrology: Responsibility
explain.body.saturn.k.responsibility.text: Saturn in astrology rules responsibility. What we have to take responsibility for, how we manage responsibilities, and where these responsibilities can come from can be found with your natal Saturn. Those with a strong natal Saturn are often forced to deal with a lot of responsibility at a young age, and this likely has to be unlearned in adulthood; fewer will run away though, and Saturn just punishes them for it.
explain.body.saturn.k.responsibility.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.maturity.title: Saturn in Astrology: Maturity
explain.body.saturn.k.maturity.text: Saturn wants us to be mature grownups. Adult like an adult. Saturn is the adult in the room, and doesn't care one iota for childish games. Where and how we mature and show maturity can be found with natal Saturn.
explain.body.saturn.k.maturity.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.authority.title: Saturn in Astrology: Authority
explain.body.saturn.k.authority.text: Saturn in astrology is ruler of authority figures. This can include leaders and bosses, as well as parents. Broadly, this includes governments, institutions, and the military. This makes Saturn a leader, along with Mars, but Mars is a leader because it's a pioneer and goes forth enthusiastically, while Saturn is a leader because it's responsible and takes on the hard jobs with maturity.
explain.body.saturn.k.authority.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.ethics.title: Saturn in Astrology: Ethics
explain.body.saturn.k.ethics.text: Saturn in astrology also rules ethics. Saturn wants us to do the right thing in the right way and for the right reasons. This is the crux with our Saturn lessons, since it's not enough to simply learn them. No, we must learn them correctly. We must be smart with what we're focused on, we must go about it in the right way for all involved, and we may be motivated for good reasons.
explain.body.saturn.k.ethics.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.k.discipline.title: Saturn in Astrology: Discipline
explain.body.saturn.k.discipline.text: Saturn in astrology rules discipline, and is a planet that wants us to be totally focused. Saturn gets annoyed when we lose focus, when we get lazy, and when we goof off. This isn't what Saturn wants. Saturn demands we be disciplined with our energy, our time, our resources, our goals, and our connections.
explain.body.saturn.k.discipline.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.where.title: Where Your Saturn Energy is Found
explain.body.saturn.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Saturn falls in. The energy of the Saturn sign and the areas of life ruled by the house your Saturn falls in are where you have major life lessons, can be restricted, and need to be disciplined. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Saturn sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Saturn falls in) as this can also connect to the Saturn energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Saturn can be restricted by Saturn, and can directly tie into the lessons you have to learn with your Saturn. You may have a hard time accessing the energy of those planets or bodies that are conjunct your natal Saturn until after you learn the lessons.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Saturn can bring some temporary energy for Saturn matters. This can impact you with your goals and discipline with Saturn but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Saturn falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Saturn rules (so the house that falls in Capricorn).

The most challenging aspects to your natal Saturn can be hard transit Pluto (since Pluto fights for power, and you may struggle with controlling the passionate side of Pluto which can put you at risk), hard transit Uranus (since Uranus is unpredictable and unconventional, this comes at odds to Saturn), and hard transit Chiron (since Chiron rules your wounds, this can open up old wounds tied to your life lessons).
explain.body.saturn.where.subject: Saturn

explain.body.saturn.strong.title: A Strong Natal Saturn in Astrology
explain.body.saturn.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Mercury. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Saturn

- your natal Saturn conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Saturn sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Saturn

- your natal Saturn anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Saturn as a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type) If your natal Saturn is in a stellium, this can restrict the stellium energy, and while stelliums are normally points of strength and talents in a natal chart, this may not be accessible to you until after you learn your Saturn lessons. This may come later in life, and may not be something you're even comfortable with when young. If your natal Saturn is conjunct an angle, this can bring highly restrictive energy to whatever that angle rules. You may not have full access to that angle until later in life. If Saturn is conjunct your Ascendant or your 1st house ruler, you may seem like a Capricorn, and come across as serious, mature, and responsible, but you may hide your true self quite a bit. If your natal Saturn is in your North Node sign, it can take time for you to access your potential and realize your purpose in life, and you may struggle quite a bit when young, but can be a powerhouse in your golden years if you learn your lessons; if your natal Saturn is in your South Node sign, you may carry a great deal of weight into this life, lots of past life and early life baggage, and this has t=o be shed to free you in this life, and your lessons might be ones that go across lifetimes.

If your natal Saturn is anaretic or a singleton, this greatly amplifies your natal Saturn energy. You can either restrict yourself too much, holding yourself back with everything and taking on too many responsibilities that aren't your own, or you can completely avoid responsibility, run away from what's right, and refuse to grow up. Middle ground is needed, managing your responsibilities but not letting others off the hook while giving yourself some breathing room. It's also extra important for you to learn your Saturn lessons, and not doing so can result in major drama and catastrophes in life.
explain.body.saturn.strong.subject: Saturn

explain.body.moon.overview.title: All About the Moon in Astrology
explain.body.moon.overview.text: The Moon in astrology is one of the most important bodies, governing your emotional self. After the Sun, it's a position you should become familiar with quickly, and we can identify strongly with our natal Moon.
explain.body.moon.overview.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.overview.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.natal.title: Moon Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.moon.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

The Moon is the natural ruling planet of the sign of Cancer, which is an emotional water sign, connecting to support and encouragement, and the Moon naturally connects with the fourth house, the house of home and family.
explain.body.moon.natal.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.natal.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Moon Keywords:
explain.body.moon.keywords.text: the emotional self · family · comfort · feminine · focus on feelings · variable · fame
explain.body.moon.keywords.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.keywords.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.the-emotional-self.title: The Moon in Astrology: The Emotional Self
explain.body.moon.k.the-emotional-self.text:
In your natal chart, your natal Moon rules your emotional self. The Moon shows how you emotionally react to situations, and what you need to feel emotionally stable, secure, and safe.

This is why the Moon is so important and is part of the main triad (with the Sun and Rising). These three positions are the very foundation of who you are as a person, and the Moon can be very personal.

Conjunctions (alignments by other planets to your Moon) tend to be strong, and can be just as important as the sign your Moon is in, if not more so depending on the planet. But, you also feel the other major aspects the planets make to your natal Moon, and they can impact emotionally.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Moon can be felt emotionally.
explain.body.moon.k.the-emotional-self.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.the-emotional-self.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.family.title: The Moon in Astrology: Family
explain.body.moon.k.family.text:
The Moon is ruler of your family, your home, and what home and family mean for you (along with your fourth house). This is where you come home, where you feel connected deeply at your core.

The Moon can show your relationship with family or to home, and your attitude around this. Natal aspects to your natal Moon can impact your home and family life, as can transit aspects.
explain.body.moon.k.family.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.family.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.comfort.title: The Moon in Astrology: Comfort
explain.body.moon.k.comfort.text:
The Moon in astrology is a comfortable position, one where we want familiarity and support. We don't like to shake things up too much with the Moon, and prefer to have some security so we can be emotionally at ease.

The Moon is our comfort zone. It's where we go when we need comfort and familiarity.
explain.body.moon.k.comfort.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.comfort.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.feminine.title: The Moon in Astrology: Feminine
explain.body.moon.k.feminine.text: The Moon in astrology is one of two feminine bodies along with Venus (or three if we count Ceres). Many asteroids are feminine, but the planets are mostly masculine. This means the Moon connects with the feminine, and can represent women in your life (often ties to the mother).
explain.body.moon.k.feminine.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.feminine.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.focus-on-feelings.title: The Moon in Astrology: Focus on Feelings
explain.body.moon.k.focus-on-feelings.text:
The transit (moving) Moon brings emotional focus to whatever it's touching in your natal chart at the time. It makes it important for us to give attention to the body, and we can feel more in tune with it emotionally.

Transit Moon aspects don't last long, just a few hours, since the transit Moon moves the fastest through the Zodiac. So, at least we don't have to deal with it too much, but since the Moon tours all 12 Zodiac signs in under one month, we experience the transit Moon in every house and making every aspect to every body in our natal chart every month.
explain.body.moon.k.focus-on-feelings.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.focus-on-feelings.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.variable.title: The Moon in Astrology: Variable
explain.body.moon.k.variable.text:
The Moon in astrology is variable, fluctuating, flowing. This is because the Moon flows as a water body (heck, it impacts the tides here on Earth and makes people all wonky at the Full Moon!).

We need to ebb and flow like water with the Moon, adapting and evolving and growing. The Moon can help us change, but in a less chaotic way (that's Uranus).
explain.body.moon.k.variable.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.variable.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.k.fame.title: The Moon in Astrology: Fame
explain.body.moon.k.fame.text: The Moon can also link to fame, oddly enough. It's because of the emotions, and the Moon can trigger the emotions in everyone. Wherever the natal Moon is located can indicate getting attention or fame for whatever the sign and house rules.
explain.body.moon.k.fame.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.k.fame.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.where.title: Where Your Moon Energy is Found
explain.body.moon.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Moon falls in. The energy of the Moon sign is your emotional self and how you react, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Moon falls in are where you're most sensitive and connected emotionally. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Moon sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Moon falls in) as this can also connect to the Moon energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Moon can be hugely important in your emotional self, and may dominate how you express yourself emotionally and what you need for security and emotional stability.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Moon can bring some temporary energy for the Moon matters. This can impact you emotionally with the Moon, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Moon falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Moon rules (so the house that falls in Cancer). These aspects can be really important when they're happening.

One of the most challenging transit aspects in astrology is hard transit Pluto to your natal Moon since Pluto likes to destroy and the Moon is emotional stability and security. This can destroy your security and bring instability galore that has a profound impact emotionally. It's important to take control and transform with those aspects. Hard transit Saturn can also be extra restrictive emotionally to the natal Moon, and hard transit Uranus can lead to emotional unpredictability. .
explain.body.moon.where.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.where.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.moon.strong.title: A Strong Natal Moon in Astrology
explain.body.moon.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal SMoo. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Moon

- your natal Moon conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Moon sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Moon

- your natal Moon anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars conjunct your natal Moon

If your natal Moon is in a stellium or conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars, it's elevated for you, and they can have a profound impact on you emotionally. You can connect with your stellium through what you feel, and the retrograde planet can cause you to operate emotionally in an unusual way.,

An anaretic natal Moon can show your emotions are extra strong, or that you're completely unattached to emotion. It goes either way. Middle ground is important with the anaretic degree, and you need to take care of your emotions and understand them and express them, but not become so lost in them that you lose objectivity and become unstable.

The Moon conjunct an angle makes that angle super important for your emotional self; conjunct your North Node, it's easier for you to grow into your potential as long as you connect emotionally; conjunct the South Node, you may have too many bad habits and crutches, or play the victim, and need to take control of yourself; and conjunct the 1st house ruler, you can feel highly attuned to your emotional self, and this can be comfortable for you to show outwardly.
explain.body.moon.strong.subject: Moon
explain.body.moon.strong.source: All about the Planets - The Moon

explain.body.sun.overview.title: All About the Sun in Astrology
explain.body.sun.overview.text: The Sun in astrology is one of the building blocks of your personality and life. It's the position most people are familiar with (or their Sun sign, anyway). The Sun is deeply personal, and it's where who we are begins to form.
explain.body.sun.overview.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.overview.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.natal.title: Sun Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.sun.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

The Sun is the natural ruling planet for the sign of Leo, which is an enthusiastic fire sign, getting that energy from the Sun, and naturally connects with the fifth house, the house of love.
explain.body.sun.natal.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.natal.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Sun Keywords:
explain.body.sun.keywords.text: the true self · personal · creative · fame · shines a light · ease · the body
explain.body.sun.keywords.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.keywords.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.the-true-self.title: The Sun in Astrology: The True Self
explain.body.sun.k.the-true-self.text: In your natal chart, your natal Sun is your true self. This is the you that comes out when you're comfortable, in comfortable settings, and with people you know well. This is the you that you hide when around strangers or in unfamiliar places. This is why the Sun is one of the building blocks for who you are as a person in astrology (along with the Moon and Rising). This is why it's such an important part of your chart. It's who you really are, underneath it all, mask removed, facade gone.
explain.body.sun.k.the-true-self.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.the-true-self.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.personal.title: The Sun in Astrology: Personal
explain.body.sun.k.personal.text:
The Sun is a deeply personal position in astrology, and this is true in both your natal chart and in transits. Whatever touches your natal Sun, you feel in a deeply personal way, and has a direct impact on who you are and your personality.

Conjunctions (alignments by other planets to your Sun) tend to be strongest, and can be just as important as the sign your Sun is in, if not more so depending on the planet. But, you also feel the other major aspects the planets make to your natal Sun, and they can determine the relationship you have with whatever those planets rule.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Sun can be felt in deeply personal ways. This is similar to the aspects by the natal planets, but those are forever while transits are temporary.
explain.body.sun.k.personal.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.personal.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.creative.title: The Sun in Astrology: Creative
explain.body.sun.k.creative.text:
The Sun in astrology is surprisingly creative, likely due to its gigantic waves of energy, but also because what we create tends to be personal and tied to who we are. What we create can mean things like artistic ventures and hobbies, or even things like people (our children).

The Sun bursts with energy, and this naturally leads to creative energy. Having a strong Sun in your natal chart often denotes you have great creative energy.
explain.body.sun.k.creative.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.creative.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.fame.title: The Sun in Astrology: Fame
explain.body.sun.k.fame.text:
The Sun in astrology connects to attention. It shines so bright, it's hard to miss, and remember it's also really personal and creative. So naturally, the Sun can connect with fame, though this doesn't have to mean celebrity (though it does rule celebrity). Any attention is covered here.

The Sun wants attention, needs attention, craves attention, is desperate for attention. Without it, it burns itself out. You may find you need attention wherever your Sun is located in your natal chart, and may temporarily need attention wherever the transit Sun is touring.
explain.body.sun.k.fame.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.fame.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.shines-a-light.title: The Sun in Astrology: Shines a Light
explain.body.sun.k.shines-a-light.text:
The transit (moving) Sun has a base energy of shining a light. This can be on the Zodiac sign it's in, which impacts everyone; or it can be on the house in your natal chart it's touring or the aspects it's making, for you personally.

The Sun puts a spotlight wherever it is. It wants to direct our attention there. Ignore it, and it might burn under the magnifying glass!
explain.body.sun.k.shines-a-light.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.shines-a-light.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.ease.title: The Sun in Astrology: Ease
explain.body.sun.k.ease.text:
The Sun doesn't like it when things are too challenging, and prefers some degree of ease. Under sextiles and trines (beneficial aspects), this can show ease and comfort and familiarity. In the natal chart, this is throughout our lives, while with transits, this is in the moment.

Under squares and oppositions (challenging aspect), this can show difficulty achieving ease, and feeling uncomfortable. In the natal chart, this can stay with us until we work on the block, while with transits, this can be temporary but may be shining a light on an issue to work on.
explain.body.sun.k.ease.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.ease.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.k.the-body.title: The Sun in Astrology: The Body
explain.body.sun.k.the-body.text: The Sun is also the ruler of the body as a whole. Each planet rules a different specific part of the body, but the Sun rules the body in totality. This means we often look to the Sun for health matters of any kind (in addition to whatever rules it specifically).
explain.body.sun.k.the-body.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.k.the-body.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.where.title: Where Your Sun Energy is Found
explain.body.sun.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Sun falls in. The energy of the Sun sign is a part of your personality, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Sun falls in are where you feel most like yourself. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Sun sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Sun falls in) as this can also connect to the Sun energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Sun can be major parts of who you are, and super important to you. Whatever that planet rules and however it expresses itself can be dominant in your personality and life.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Sun can bring some temporary energy for the Sun matters. This can impact you personally with the Sun, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Sun falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Sun rules (so the house that falls in Leo). These aspects can be really important when they're happening.

One of the most challenging transit aspects in astrology is hard transit Pluto to your natal Sun since Pluto likes to destroy and the Sun is so personal. You always want to plan ahead for that! Hard transit Saturn can also be extra restrictive to the natal Sun, and hard transit Uranus can be extra unpredictable.
explain.body.sun.where.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.where.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.sun.strong.title: A Strong Natal Sun in Astrology
explain.body.sun.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Sun. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Sun

- your natal Sun conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Sun sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Sun

- your natal Sun anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars conjunct your natal Sun

One thing about the natal Sun, is it can easily be overtaken by other planets and likes to be neutral. If your natal Sun is in a stellium or conjunct a retrograde Mercury, Venus, or Mars, it's elevated for you, and you feel these deeply personally, and have to learn to work with them, otherwise they can control you and make things difficult for you.

An anaretic natal Sun can show you have a personality that is amplified times 11, or that you hide your true self so much that you're not even sure who you really are. It goes either way. Balance becomes important, knowing who you are and having confidence in that, but not going so far as to become arrogant and cocky. The Sun conjunct an angle greatly amplifies that angle in your life; conjunct your North Node, it's easier for you to grow into your potential; conjunct the South Node, it's easier for you to fall back on crutches and need to get out of your own way; and conjunct the 1st house ruler, you can actually fuse your inner and outer self to be more cohesive, and you may be more comfortable showing who you really are.
explain.body.sun.strong.subject: Sun
explain.body.sun.strong.source: All about the Planets - The Sun

explain.body.uranus.overview.title: All About Uranus in Astrology
explain.body.uranus.overview.text: Uranus in astrology is one of the outer planets, along with Neptune and Pluto, and these are the generational planets since they move slowly and entire generations can have them in the same signs. Uranus is the one who challenges the norm and shakes things up.
explain.body.uranus.overview.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.natal.title: Uranus Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.uranus.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Uranus is the natural ruling planet of air sign Aquarius, the sign of friends and groups, and connects with the eleventh house, the house of dreams and change.
explain.body.uranus.natal.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Uranus Keywords:
explain.body.uranus.keywords.text: change · unconventional · independent · charity · groups · the future · science
explain.body.uranus.keywords.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.change.title: Uranus in Astrology: Change
explain.body.uranus.k.change.text:
Uranus is, first and foremost, the planet of change in astrology. In your natal chart, this can show how you change, your approach to change, and where you change. You can crave changes throughout your life with the areas of life ruled by the house your natal Uranus falls in. Things just can't stay the same for very long before you get bored. Change is how you stay focused with these areas, and it's how you best grow and learn.

In transit, transit (moving) Uranus can bring changes to whatever it's touching in your natal chart. You can experience changes in the areas of life ruled by the house transit Uranus is currently touring, and you can experience changes that are helpful with beneficial aspects (sextiles and trines) to your natal planets, and have challenging changes with challenging aspects (squares and oppositions). When transit Uranus is conjunct something in your natal chart., whatever it rules can undergo a major, massive change.
explain.body.uranus.k.change.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.unconventional.title: Uranus in Astrology: Unconventional
explain.body.uranus.k.unconventional.text:
Uranus is the planet of the unconventional, and this links to it ruling change. Uranus wants to focus on what's different, to step outside comfort zones and push boundaries. Uranus doesn't care about tradition or what's conventional or "normal" .

Normal is totally overrated to Uranus.
explain.body.uranus.k.unconventional.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.independent.title: Uranus in Astrology: Independent
explain.body.uranus.k.independent.text: Uranus is one of the independent planets in astrology (along with Mars and Jupiter, I'd say). Uranus is independent because it wants to do things in its own way, and its own way if totally different from everyone else's.
explain.body.uranus.k.independent.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.charity.title: Uranus in Astrology: Charity
explain.body.uranus.k.charity.text: Uranus rules charity in astrology, and this is helping others in a broad way. Neptune rules volunteer work and helping people one-on-one, while Uranus takes a wider view and opts for helping in ways that have a bigger impact on more people. Uranus is the humanitarian and the environmentalist.
explain.body.uranus.k.charity.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.groups.title: Uranus in Astrology: Groups
explain.body.uranus.k.groups.text:
Uranus also rules groups, which is funny because it also rules independence, but Uranus can see how things impact everyone broadly, which makes it a good temperature-taker for groups. Uranus can understand what is needed to work well with groups, and can feel it out.

This also means Uranus is ruler of friends, our social circle, and our acquaintances.
explain.body.uranus.k.groups.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.the-future.title: Uranus in Astrology: The Future
explain.body.uranus.k.the-future.text: Uranus is the planetary ruler of the future, and is focused on not the next step, or the step after that, but 100 steps later. It peers into the future and beyond, and this is part of what helps Uranus be charitable and work well with groups. It has a sense of where the future is headed.
explain.body.uranus.k.the-future.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.k.science.title: Uranus in Astrology: Science
explain.body.uranus.k.science.text: Uranus is one of the science rulers in astrology along with Pluto. Pluto is into science because it loves research and investigation, solving problems and asking hard questions. Uranus is into science because it loves change and understands the future, and science provides a way to create big changes and launch us into the future.
explain.body.uranus.k.science.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.where.title: Where Your Uranus Energy is Found
explain.body.uranus.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Uranus falls in. The energy of the Uranus sign is how you change, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Uranus falls in are where you need change. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Uranus sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Uranus falls in) as this can also connect to the Uranus energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Uranus can show areas of your life where you experience constant change, and have to embrace things being very different from the norm. Nothing traditional here!

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Uranus can bring some temporary energy for Uranus matters. This can impact change with Uranus but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Uranus falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the house your Uranus rules (so the house that falls in Aquarius). The most challenging aspects to your natal Uranus can be hard transit Saturn (since Saturn is traditional and restrictive, this can bring challenges with change and being independent and unconventional) and hard transit Neptune (since Neptune is foggy, this can make it difficult to grasp change and to see what happening fully until it's too late and too much has been thrown off).
explain.body.uranus.where.subject: Uranus

explain.body.uranus.strong.title: A Strong Natal Uranus in Astrology
explain.body.uranus.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Uranus. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Uranus

- your natal Uranus conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Uranus sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Uranus

- your natal Uranus anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Uranus as a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type) If your natal Uranus is in a stellium, this can bring an unconventional flavor to your stellium. Change is likely needed to make use of the stellium, and you can do things differently. There can be flashes of brilliance and sudden progress at times with the stellium, and you may not be able to do things in a traditional way.

If your natal Uranus is conjunct an angle, this can bring unconventional energy to whatever that angle rules. You may experience many changes in your life with those areas of life, and you likely need more independence. If your natal Uranus is conjunct your Ascendant or your 1st house ruler, you may come across like an Aquarius, and can be seen as quirky and eclectic. If your natal Uranus is in your natal North Node sign, you may suddenly attain your potential and purpose, and find you make progress quickly or even instantly, and whatever your potential and purpose is, it's likely unusual in some way; and if your natal Uranus is in your South Node sign, you may feel super independent and unconventional and comfortable with this, however you may push everyone and everything away to maintain this, and this leads to loneliness and feeling like a freak, so that has to be worked on. If your natal Uranus is anaretic or a singleton, this greatly amplifies your natal Uranus energy. You can either be a super individual, completely anti tradition, and refuse to be boxed in at your own peril as you constantly rebel even when you're not a teenager, or you avoid this completely and are terrified of being independent, of standing out, or of change. You need middle ground here, to be independent and embrace change and your quirks, while also recognizing there are times when the traditional and conventional are the best option.
explain.body.uranus.strong.subject: Uranus

explain.body.venus.overview.title: All About Venus in Astrology
explain.body.venus.overview.text: Venus in astrology is one of the personal planets, along with Mercury and Mars. We feel the personal planets in a personal way, and they deeply connect with our personal lives.
explain.body.venus.overview.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.natal.title: Venus Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.body.venus.natal.text:
There are ten planets in a standard astrology chart (I personally also add Ceres, and there are others, but we start with the ten). Each planet links to a different part of your personality and life. Your natal chart is a snapshot of the locations of the planets, other bodies, and houses in the Zodiac at the moment you're born and from the location you're born at.

Venus is the natural ruling planet for two signs, earthy Taurus who is sensual and indulgent, and airy Libra who rules connections and relationships, Venus naturally connects with two houses, the second house of money and seventh house of commitment.
explain.body.venus.natal.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Venus Keywords:
explain.body.venus.keywords.text: connections · attraction · sensual · grounded · charming · feminine · values
explain.body.venus.keywords.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.connections.title: Venus in Astrology: Connections
explain.body.venus.k.connections.text:
In your natal chart, your natal Venus rules your relationships, how you are in relationships, who you gravitate toward, and the kind of relationships you're in. This is mostly found via your Venus sign, and the house in your natal chart natal Venus falls in can show areas where you deal with people a lot, need a more pleasant environment, make compromises, and want to keep the peace with others. Conjunctions (alignments by other planets to your Venus) tend to be strong, and can dominate your natal Venus and your relationships. You can feel surrounded by people and relationships who are ruled by that planet, and that planet can be most important for your connections.

When it comes to transits, the transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Venus can be felt in your dealings with others. They can impact your ability to connect and commit, to get along, and to be invested in others.
explain.body.venus.k.connections.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.attraction.title: Venus in Astrology: Attraction
explain.body.venus.k.attraction.text:
Venus is the planet of attraction, and this means what we attract and how we attract it. How we attract can be found via the sign Venus is in, and where this can occur can be found via the house Venus is in. Venus doesn't necessarily need to go out and take things itself, and rather lets things come to it.

Attraction can also mean the attraction we have with others and with ourselves. What we find attractive in others, and what others find attractive in us, can be seen via Venus.
explain.body.venus.k.attraction.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.sensual.title: Venus in Astrology: Sensual
explain.body.venus.k.sensual.text: Venus is a sensual planet. Venus is ruler of the senses, and is one of the planets that connects to the physical world. Venus wants to experience everything via the senses, and can overindulge. This links to Taurus.
explain.body.venus.k.sensual.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.grounded.title: Venus in Astrology: Grounded
explain.body.venus.k.grounded.text: Venus in astrology is a grounded planet. Venus doesn't want to rush, and this is part of its attractive energy. Venus doesn't need to rush, and this allows Venus to be grounded and centered. This also helps Venus with maintaining peace, balance, and harmony. It's a blend of Taurus and Libra.
explain.body.venus.k.grounded.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.charming.title: Venus in Astrology: Charming
explain.body.venus.k.charming.text: Venus is a charming planet. This aids its attractive quality, and helps with getting along with others. Venus is pleasant, easy, and can understand how to win people over. It can turn up the charm in just the right way to get others on its side.
explain.body.venus.k.charming.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.feminine.title: Venus in Astrology: Feminine
explain.body.venus.k.feminine.text:
Venus is one of only two feminine planets in astrology, with the other being the Moon. If you also count Ceres as a main planet, then there are three, but the Moon and Venus are the OG's.

This means the Moon and Venus are feminine energy, and with Venus, this can be an alter ego for women. It can link to the women in your life, and transit Venus can impact issues affecting all women.
explain.body.venus.k.feminine.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.k.values.title: Venus in Astrology: Values
explain.body.venus.k.values.text: Venus connects with our values, with what makes us feel secure and confident, and what brings grounding to our lives. Venus can show where our values come from and what we value most.
explain.body.venus.k.values.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.where.title: Where Your Venus Energy is Found
explain.body.venus.where.text:
For everyone, look to the Zodiac sign and natal house your Venus falls in. The energy of the Venus sign is how you connect and commit, while the areas of life ruled by the house your Venus falls in are where you need to come together and work with others. Also look to the natural planetary ruler of your Venus sign (the natural planetary ruler of the Zodiac sign your Venus falls in) as this can also connect to the Venus energy.

Planets that are conjunct (aligned with) your natal Venus can be super important and have a direct impact on your relationships. They might be more dominant than the sign Venus is in since Venus is easily overtaken by other bodies.

Transit (moving) planets aspecting your natal Venus can bring some temporary energy for Venus matters. This can impact your relationships with Venus, but can also impact the areas of life ruled by the house your Venus falls in, as well as the areas of life ruled by the houses your Venus rules (so the houses that fall in Taurus and Libra).

The most challenging aspects to your natal Venus can be hard transit Pluto (since Pluto brings out power struggles, control issues, and old relationship baggage and trauma), hard transit Saturn (since Saturn restricts and can wipe people out of your life), and hard transit Uranus (since Uranus is change and can bring sudden breakups and betrayals).
explain.body.venus.where.subject: Venus

explain.body.venus.strong.title: A Strong Natal Venus in Astrology
explain.body.venus.strong.text:
Some may have a more important natal Venus. This can be the case for you if you have:

- a stellium (3+ planets) including your natal Venus

- your natal Venus conjunct an angle

- your North or South Node in your Venus sign

- your 1st house ruler conjunct the natal Venus

- your natal Venus anaretic (at 29 degrees)

- natal Venus retrograde

- retrograde Mercury or Mars conjunct your natal Venus

If your natal Venus is in a stellium, this can make your relationships an important part of that stellium, and your connections with others can be super important for your life happiness but may come with a myriad of challenges to work through. If your natal Venus is conjunct a retrograde Mercury or Mars, or is retrograde itself, you may struggle with connecting with others in what you'd consider a "normal" way. There is

likely something different about the way you connect with others, and you have to be accepting of being different with this.

An anaretic natal Venus can show you either are constantly with others and never alone, or constantly alone and afraid of others. That's the nature of the anaretic degree, and you need to find middle ground. Work on healthy connections with others that benefit your life, and don't be so afraid.

Venus conjunct an angle makes your relationships more important for that angle; conjunct your North Node, and healthy connections can be the key to happiness in your life; conjunct the South Node, and you may rely on others too much and need to learn more interdependence; and conjunct the first house ruler, you can be more charming, pleasant, diplomatic, attractive, and able to connect.
explain.body.venus.strong.subject: Venus

explain.sign.aquarius.overview.title: All About Aquarius in Astrology
explain.sign.aquarius.overview.text: Aquarius is one of the 12 Zodiac signs in astrology, and this is the eleventh sign of the Zodiac. Each Zodiac sign has its own energy, and this shows how the energy is expressed for different planets, bodies, and other positions. You're likely most familiar with your Sun sign, and an Aquarius Sun is unconventional, unique, and independent.
explain.sign.aquarius.overview.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.natal.title: Aquarius Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.sign.aquarius.natal.text:
Wherever Aquarius is present in your natal chart, this is an area where you're different and innovative. If you have any natal planets in Aquarius, you can feel the Aquarius energy strongly personally with whatever that planet rules.

Aquarius is an air sign, along with Gemini and Libra, and the air signs are intellectual and sociable. Aquarius is also a fixed sign, along with Taurus, Leo, and Scorpio, and the fixed signs are stable. Aquarius connects with the 11th house of dreams and friends, and is ruled by changemaker Uranus.
explain.sign.aquarius.natal.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Aquarius Keywords:
explain.sign.aquarius.keywords.text: unconventional · independent · inventive · future-focused · friendly · dreams · hope · cold
explain.sign.aquarius.keywords.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.unconventional.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Unconventional
explain.sign.aquarius.k.unconventional.text: Aquarius is the most unconventional Zodiac sign, mostly thanks to being ruled by Uranus, the planet of change and what's different. Aquarius is totally okay with stepping outside of comfort zones, and can push for things to be different. Aquarius understands why this is important, and feels this helps stay true to itself.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.unconventional.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.independent.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Independent
explain.sign.aquarius.k.independent.text: Aquarius is a highly independent sign, one of the most independent (along with Aries and Sagittarius). Aquarius wants to do things in its own time and in its own way, and trying to box in Aquarius is quite the challenge. This can make Aquarius rebellious at times, and it can push buttons.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.independent.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.inventive.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Inventive
explain.sign.aquarius.k.inventive.text: Aquarius is an inventive Zodiac sign, partly because it's so open to change, so unconventional, and so willing to carve its own path. Aquarius is open to experimentation, and has quite the intellect, so this assists in its innovative mind. Aquarius is one of the science rules (along with Scorpio).
explain.sign.aquarius.k.inventive.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.future-focused.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Future-focused
explain.sign.aquarius.k.future-focused.text: Aquarius rules the future, and is constantly focused on the future. This isn't just standard long-term; Aquarius can look forward many generations, hundreds and thousands of years into the future, and decades into its own life. This helps make Aquarius a humanitarian since it sees how it can impact the world at large, and this sign governs charity.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.future-focused.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.friendly.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Friendly
explain.sign.aquarius.k.friendly.text: Aquarius is a sociable air sign, and is the ruler of friends and social circles, so Aquarius is comfortable with lots of different people of various backgrounds. Aquarius can interact well with others in many ways, both in person and online. Aquarius likes having a variety of friends and acquaintances.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.friendly.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.dreams.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Dreams
explain.sign.aquarius.k.dreams.text: Aquarius rules dreams for the future, and because it's so future-focused, it can set big dreams. Aquarius understands that those dreams don't have to happen tomorrow, and it can work on them for many years and decades to come.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.dreams.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.hope.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Hope
explain.sign.aquarius.k.hope.text: Aquarius is the sign of hope, and since this sign can look so far into the future and dreams of what it wants, it can be quite hopeful. Aquarius can be at its best when it has hope, and is instilling hope in others.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.hope.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.k.cold.title: Aquarius in Astrology: Cold
explain.sign.aquarius.k.cold.text: When not manifesting well, Aquarius can be the coldest of the Zodiac signs. Aquarius can live in its head and in the future, and while it loves lots of friends, they can be superficial connections. Aquarius has to learn to form strong emotional connections, and can be quite loyal once it does thanks to being a fixed sign.
explain.sign.aquarius.k.cold.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.where.title: Where Your Aquarius Energy is Found
explain.sign.aquarius.where.text:
If you have any natal planets in Aquarius, the way those planets express themselves is via Aquarius, so they are unconventional, inventive, and hopeful. The more Aquarius planets you have, the more Aquarius-like you can be.

Even if you have no natal planets in Aquarius, you will have at least one natal house with Aquarius. The house that falls in Aquarius (has Aquarius on the house cusp) can show areas of life where you take an unconventional, hopeful approach. If you have no Aquarius house cusps, Aquarius is intercepted (contained) in the house that falls in Capricorn, and your Aquarius energy can manifest subconsciously with whatever that house rules.
explain.sign.aquarius.where.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.transit.title: Transit Planets in Aquarius
explain.sign.aquarius.transit.text:
When the transit (moving) planets are in Aquarius, this can give all of us some Aquarius energy to play with. The transit Sun is in Aquarius roughly every year from mid January to mid February, and this is Aquarius Season, which brings greater emphasis on change and independence for us all.

Transit Mercury in Aquarius helps us to think outside the box and bounce ideas off of groups; transit Venus in Aquarius can help us connect with friends and make changes in love; transit Mars in Aquarius can make us more independent and willing to make changes; transit Ceres in Aquarius can help us take an unconventional approach with resources and make changes with them; and transit Jupiter in Aquarius brings opportunities to change, be different, and push norms. Transit Saturn in Aquarius brings out issues we have with Aquarius, so usually issues around independence, our dreams, and change. Any issues around that, we can struggle with, and Saturn can prompt us to work it out. Saturn was just in Aquarius 2020-2023 (and won't be again until 2050).

Transit Uranus won't be in Aquarius until 2079 (and was last in Aquarius 1995-2003), but we'll experience many changes in general since Uranus rules Aquarius. Transit Neptune won't be in Aquarius until 2161 (and was last in Aquarius 1998-2012), but at that point, we'll experiment spiritually. Transit Chiron moves to Aquarius in 2055 (and was last in Aquarius 2005-2010), and we can tackle issues of independence and individuality.

Transit Pluto is moving to Aquarius now, and this will demand we transform our dreams, the future, and make changes that transform.
explain.sign.aquarius.transit.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aquarius.strong.title: Strong Aquarius Energy in Astrology
explain.sign.aquarius.strong.text:
When multiple planets are in Aquarius in your natal chart, this can give you strong Aquarius energy in your life and personality. You can be unconventional, independent, and eccentric. This can be the case if you have an Aquarius stellium (3+ planets in one Zodiac sign), or if you have 2 of your primary triad (Sun, Moon, Rising) in Aquarius.

You can also feel that you have strong Aquarius energy if your natal Uranus is strong, which is the planet that rules Aquarius. This can be the case if your natal Uranus is conjunct your natal Sun, Moon or Ascendant, or your 1st house ruler, or if your natal Uranus is a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type). When multiple transit planets are in Aquarius, this gives all of us a strong dose of Aquarius energy all at once. We can make changes and embrace the

unconventional. How we end up feeling this personally is usually focused on the house in your natal chart the Aquarius energy occurs in.
explain.sign.aquarius.strong.subject: Aquarius

explain.sign.aries.overview.title: All About Aries in Astrology
explain.sign.aries.overview.text: Aries is one of the 12 Zodiac signs in astrology, and this is the very first sign of the Zodiac. Each Zodiac sign has its own energy, and this shows how the energy is expressed for different planets, bodies, and other positions. You're likely most familiar with your Sun sign, and an Aries Sun is independent and pioneering in some way.
explain.sign.aries.overview.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.natal.title: Aries Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.sign.aries.natal.text:
Wherever Aries is present in your natal chart, this is an area full of energy, enthusiasm, and drive. If you have any natal planets in Aries, you can feel the Aries energy strong personally with whatever that planet rules.

Aries is a fire sign, along with Leo and Sagittarius, and the fire signs are full of energy and excitement. Aries is also a cardinal sign, along with Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn, and the cardinal signs are the signs of action. Aries connects with the 1st house of the self, and is ruled by assertive Mars.
explain.sign.aries.natal.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Aries Keywords:
explain.sign.aries.keywords.text: energy · enthusiasm and excitement · drive and motivation · pioneering and independent · positive · assertive · leader · impatient and impulsive
explain.sign.aries.keywords.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.energy.title: Aries in Astrology: Energy
explain.sign.aries.k.energy.text: Aries is the most energetic sign in astrology. This is because it's ruled by the planet of energy, Mars, and is a fire sign (full of energy) and a cardinal sign (active). Aries has great difficulty being still, and gets bored pretty easily. You can see this with whatever is ruled by any natal Aries planets or bodies.
explain.sign.aries.k.energy.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.enthusiasm-and-exci.title: Aries in Astrology: Enthusiasm and Excitement
explain.sign.aries.k.enthusiasm-and-exci.text: Aries in astrology is enthusiastic and excited. This sign has so much energy and it's constantly excited about what it can do. Since it's the first Zodiac sign, it's the baby, and its enthusiasm is pure and innocent.
explain.sign.aries.k.enthusiasm-and-exci.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.drive-and-motivatio.title: Aries in Astrology: Drive and Motivation
explain.sign.aries.k.drive-and-motivatio.text: With Aries being so high energy, enthusiastic, and excited, it's also the sign of drive and motivation. This is thanks to Mars being its planetary ruler. Aries is driven to take action, motivated to get going, and doesn't like to sit around and let motivation pass it by.
explain.sign.aries.k.drive-and-motivatio.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.pioneering-and-inde.title: Aries in Astrology: Pioneering and Independent
explain.sign.aries.k.pioneering-and-inde.text: Since Aries is the very first Zodiac sign, that makes it pioneering. Aries is willing to go down new roads that no one else has gone down before, and blaze a new trail for everyone else. This makes Aries highly independent, and wants to do its own thing.
explain.sign.aries.k.pioneering-and-inde.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.positive.title: Aries in Astrology: Positive
explain.sign.aries.k.positive.text: Aries is a positive sign thanks to being a fire sign. The first signs (including Leo and Sagittarius) are positive signs, always wanting to look at the bright side and not be too serious. Aries wants to see the good in everything and everyone.
explain.sign.aries.k.positive.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.assertive.title: Aries in Astrology: Assertive
explain.sign.aries.k.assertive.text: Aries in astrology is an assertive sign. This is part of Aries being an independent pioneering, driven and enthusiastic and positive. It needs to be assertive with all of that. On the flip side, this can become aggression thanks to being ruled by Mars, one of the rulers of war, so Aries can have a temper and snap fairly easily.
explain.sign.aries.k.assertive.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.leader.title: Aries in Astrology: Leader
explain.sign.aries.k.leader.text: Aries is one of the signs that leads in astrology. This is thanks to Aries being a cardinal sign, who are the leaders in astrology, and thanks to Aries being the first sign. As a pioneer, Aries is willing to take the lead, to show the way. Aries may not explain it very well though, and doesn't want to wait around for others to catch up, so it's more, lead by example, instead of being a nurturing and attentive leader.
explain.sign.aries.k.leader.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.k.impatient-and-impul.title: Aries in Astrology: Impatient and Impulsive
explain.sign.aries.k.impatient-and-impul.text: Aries is highly impatient and impulsive thanks to all of this energy. Aries won't wait for anyone, it needs to GO-GO-GO! Aries doesn't want to wait to think things through, and can be quite impulsive as a result. We can get burned because of this, so a lesson for Aries is learning patience and the importance of doing your homework.
explain.sign.aries.k.impatient-and-impul.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.where.title: Where Your Aries Energy is Found
explain.sign.aries.where.text:
If you have any natal planets in Aries, the way those planets express themselves is via Aries, so they are energetic, enthusiastic, and independent. The more Aries planets you have, the more Aries-like you can be.

Even if you have no natal planets in Aries, you will have at least one natal house with Aries. The house that falls in Aries (has Aries on the house cusp) can show areas of life where you take an energetic, independent approach. If you have no Aries house cusps, Aries is intercepted (contained) in the house that falls in Pisces, and your Aries energy can manifest subconsciously with whatever that house rules.
explain.sign.aries.where.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.transit.title: Transit Planets in Aries
explain.sign.aries.transit.text:
When the transit (moving) planets are in Aries, this can give all of us some Aries energy to play with. The transit Sun is in Aries roughly every year from late March to mid April, and this is Aries Season, which brings greater enthusiasm and excitement for us all.

Transit Mercury in Aries can make us more enthusiastic in communication; transit Venus in Aries can make us more enthusiastic in love; transit Mars in Aries doubles the energy since Mars rules Aries, transit Ceres in Aries helps us take the initiative with our resources and support; and transit Jupiter in Aries makes us extra independent and brings opportunities for utilizing energy and drive to our benefit. Transit Saturn in Aries can bring out issues we have with Aries, so issues around being independent, taking initiative, using energy, and being enthusiastic. Any issues around that, we can struggle with, and Saturn can prompt us to work it out. This is coming soon with transit Saturn moving to Aries in 2026.

Transit Uranus was recently in Aries, and helped us to be extra independent and take charge with change in our lives. Transit Neptune is moving to Aries in a few years, and we'll be more in charge with our spiritual lives. Transit Chiron is currently in Aries, and we're more take charge with our healing and growth.

Transit Pluto won't be in Aries for a looooong time, but when it is, we'll be more take charge with transformations and power.
explain.sign.aries.transit.subject: Aries

explain.sign.aries.strong.title: Strong Aries Energy in Astrology
explain.sign.aries.strong.text:
When multiple planets are in Aries in your natal chart, this can give you strong Aries energy in your life and personality. You can be energetic, enthusiastic, and positive. This can be the case if you have an Aries stellium (3+ planets in one Zodiac sign), or if you have 2 of your primary triad (Sun, Moon, Rising) in Aries.

You can also feel that you have strong Aries energy if your natal Mars is strong, which is the planet that rules Aries. This can be the case if your natal Mars is conjunct your natal Sun, Moon, or Ascendant, or your 1st house ruler, or if your natal Mars is a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type). When multiple transit planets are in Aries, this gives all of us a strong dose of Aries energy all at once. We're all energetic and enthusiastic and ready for action. How we end up feeling this personally is usually focused on the house in your natal chart the Aries energy occurs in.
explain.sign.aries.strong.subject: Aries

explain.sign.cancer.overview.title: All About Cancer in Astrology
explain.sign.cancer.overview.text: Cancer is one of the 12 Zodiac signs in astrology, and this is the fourth sign of the Zodiac. Each Zodiac sign has its own energy, and this shows how the energy is expressed for different planets, bodies, and other positions. You're likely most familiar with your Sun sign, and a Cancer Sun is sensitive and supportive in some way.
explain.sign.cancer.overview.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.natal.title: Cancer Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.sign.cancer.natal.text:
Wherever Cancer is present in your natal chart, this is an area full of emotion. If you have any natal planets in Cancer, you can feel the Cancer energy strong personally with whatever that planet rules.

Cancer is a water sign, along with Scorpio and Pisces, and the water signs are full of emotion. Cancer is also a cardinal sign, along with Aries, Libra, and Capricorn, and the cardinal signs are the ones who take action. Cancer connects with the 4th house of the home and family, and is ruled by the emotional Moon.
explain.sign.cancer.natal.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Cancer Keywords:
explain.sign.cancer.keywords.text: emotion · support and nurture · creative · fluctuating · home, family, roots · comfort and familiarity · inner foundation · subjective
explain.sign.cancer.keywords.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.emotion.title: Cancer in Astrology: Emotion
explain.sign.cancer.k.emotion.text: Cancer is the sign of emotion in astrology. Cancer is a sensitive water sign and ruled by the watery Moon, so Cancer can feel everything. It may not be super open about this sometimes though, and can hide behind its hard shell. When it becomes the crabby Crab, it's probably been holding it in for some time.
explain.sign.cancer.k.emotion.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.support-and-nurtur.title: Cancer in Astrology: Support and Nurture
explain.sign.cancer.k.support-and-nurtur.text: Cancer rules support, the support we get and give, and craves a solid support system. Cancer is the nurturer as the sign of the mother, and can be extremely nurturing, supportive, and encouraging of loved ones. Cancer is a great cheerleader.
explain.sign.cancer.k.support-and-nurtur.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.creative.title: Cancer in Astrology: Creative
explain.sign.cancer.k.creative.text: Cancer can be surprisingly creative, and creativity serves as a great outlet for all of its emotions. Cancer can channel what it feels into a creative project or hobby, and can take charge with creative ventures with zeal.
explain.sign.cancer.k.creative.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.fluctuating.title: Cancer in Astrology: Fluctuating
explain.sign.cancer.k.fluctuating.text: Since Cancer is ruled by the Moon, Cancer can fluctuate, just like the tides with the lunar phases. Cancer is deeply in tune with the fluctuations all around us, and so it ebbs and flows. This can give Cancer some degree of adaptability, and it can ride with the tides.
explain.sign.cancer.k.fluctuating.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.home-family-roots.title: Cancer in Astrology: Home, Family, Roots
explain.sign.cancer.k.home-family-roots.text: Cancer rules the home and family in astrology, and is our roots in life. This ties to our early lives, our childhoods, and upbringings. When we want to get back to our roots or back to basics, this is Cancer. Cancer craves a solid home base, and a healthy definition of family.
explain.sign.cancer.k.home-family-roots.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.comfort-and-famili.title: Cancer in Astrology: Comfort and Familiarity
explain.sign.cancer.k.comfort-and-famili.text: Cancer is astrology rules comfort and familiarity. This sign wants to settle down and be in a space that it knows well. Cancer doesn't care for anything too new or too unconventional. It wants to stay within its comfort zone, and can work with that well, but it often needs to learn how to work with change.
explain.sign.cancer.k.comfort-and-famili.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.inner-foundation.title: Cancer in Astrology: Inner Foundation
explain.sign.cancer.k.inner-foundation.text: Cancer is our inner foundation, as well as the foundation of most things in our lives. Cancer wants a strong core to build from, and without that, can become difficult. Cancer needs that strong internal foundation, and can thrive with it.
explain.sign.cancer.k.inner-foundation.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.k.subjective.title: Cancer in Astrology: Subjective
explain.sign.cancer.k.subjective.text: Cancer is a subjective sign, and this is because it can get really wrapped up in what it's feeling that it kind of forgets everyone else. Cancer has to learn how to be more objective, how to take a step back and perhaps a step outside of itself so it can get a better view of the big picture.
explain.sign.cancer.k.subjective.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.where.title: Where Your Cancer Energy is Found
explain.sign.cancer.where.text:
If you have any natal planets in Cancer, the way those planets express themselves is via Cancer, so they are emotional, creative, and supportive. The more Cancer planets you have, the more Cancer-like you can be.

Even if you have no natal planets in Cancer, you will have at least one natal house with Cancer. The house that falls in Cancer (has Cancer on the house cusp) can show areas of life where you take an emotional approach. If you have no Cancer house cusps, Cancer is intercepted (contained) in the house that falls in Gemini, and your Cancer energy can manifest subconsciously with whatever that house rules.
explain.sign.cancer.where.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.transit.title: Transit Planets in Cancer
explain.sign.cancer.transit.text:
When the transit (moving) planets are in Cancer, this can give all of us some Cancer energy to play with. The transit Sun is in Cancer roughly every year from mid June to mid July, and this is Cancer Season, which brings greater emotions and support for us all.

Transit Mercury in Cancer can merge our hearts and minds; transit Venus in Cancer can make for stronger emotional connections in love; transit Mars in Cancer makes emotions motivate us; transit Ceres in Cancer emphasizes nourishment and support; and transit Jupiter in Cancer makes us extra supportive and brings opportunities for strong foundations to build on.

Transit Saturn in Cancer can bring out issues we have with Cancer, so issues around taking care of our emotional needs, feeling emotionally stable and secure, having a solid home life, and having a strong foundation. Any issues around that, we can struggle with, and Saturn can prompt us to work it out. Saturn won't be in Cancer again until 2032 (and last was 2003-2005).

Transit Uranus also moves to Cancer in 2032, and we'll experience a lot of changes with our home and family lives, our foundations, and this can have a strong impact on us emotionally. Transit Neptune won't be in Cancer until 2065, but at that point, we'll have strong emotional connections to our spiritual selves. Transit Chiron moves to Cancer in 2038, and we can tackle emotional healing.

Transit Pluto isn't in Cancer until 2157 (hello vampires?), and that can bring major transformations of foundations, homes, and emotions.
explain.sign.cancer.transit.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.cancer.strong.title: Strong Cancer Energy in Astrology
explain.sign.cancer.strong.text:
When multiple planets are in Cancer in your natal chart, this can give you strong Cancer energy in your life and personality. You can be emotional, creative, and nurturing. This can be the case if you have a Cancer stellium (3+ planets in one Zodiac sign), or if you have 2 of your primary triad (Sun, Moon, Rising) in Cancer. You can also feel that you have strong Cancer energy if your natal Moon is strong, which is the planet that rules Cancer. This can be the case if your natal Moon is conjunct your natal Sun or Ascendant, or your 1st house ruler, or if your natal Moon is a singleton (only planet in an element, modality, or house type).

When multiple transit planets are in Cancer, this gives all of us a strong dose of Cancer energy all at once. We're all emotional and in need of comfort. How we end up feeling this personally is usually focused on the house in your natal chart the Cancer energy occurs in.
explain.sign.cancer.strong.subject: Cancer

explain.sign.capricorn.overview.title: All About Capricorn in Astrology
explain.sign.capricorn.overview.text: Capricorn is one of the 12 Zodiac signs in astrology, and this is the tenth sign of the Zodiac. Each Zodiac sign has its own energy, and this shows how the energy is expressed for different planets, bodies, and other positions. You're likely most familiar with your Sun sign, and a Capricorn Sun is practical, focused, and ambitious.
explain.sign.capricorn.overview.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.natal.title: Capricorn Astrology & Your Natal Chart
explain.sign.capricorn.natal.text:
Wherever Capricorn is present in your natal chart, this is an area where you're practical and responsible. If you have any natal planets in Capricorn, you can feel the Capricorn energy strongly personally with whatever that planet rules.

Capricorn is an earth sign, along with Taurus and Virgo, and the earth signs are practical and hard-working. Capricorn is also a cardinal sign, along with Aries, Cancer, and Libra, and the cardinal signs are leaders. Capricorn connects with the 10th house of goals and direction, and is ruled by disciplinarian Saturn.
explain.sign.capricorn.natal.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.keywords.title: At-a-Glance Capricorn Keywords:
explain.sign.capricorn.keywords.text: ambitious · disciplined · responsible · practical · focused · authority · traditional · distant
explain.sign.capricorn.keywords.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.ambitious.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Ambitious
explain.sign.capricorn.k.ambitious.text: Capricorn is the highest sign of the Zodiac, which links it to ambition. It's what we're striving for in life. This makes Capricorn a highly ambitious sign, and it wants to achieve and succeed. If it can keep perspective, it can avoid tragic ambition, and can achieve respectability.
explain.sign.capricorn.k.ambitious.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.disciplined.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Disciplined
explain.sign.capricorn.k.disciplined.text: Capricorn is a disciplined sign, and wants to focus on what it wants to achieve in a disciplined way. It can stay focused no matter what, for the long haul, and often it does take time for Capricorn to achieve. It's the late bloomer, but that's okay, because what it builds can last.
explain.sign.capricorn.k.disciplined.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.responsible.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Responsible
explain.sign.capricorn.k.responsible.text: Capricorn is the sign of responsibility, and can take on a lot. Capricorn can handle more than most signs, and can be seen as very mature and often older. But, this can lead to taking on too much, so it usually needs to learn how to have some boundaries, balance, and take care of itself.
explain.sign.capricorn.k.responsible.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.practical.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Practical
explain.sign.capricorn.k.practical.text: Capricorn is a practical earth sign, and doesn't get lost in fantasies and imagination, nor in its mind and emotions. Capricorn is rooted in the physical world as an earth sign, and wants to feel everything in a tangible way. Whimsy isn't usually Capricorn's thing.
explain.sign.capricorn.k.practical.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.focused.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Focused
explain.sign.capricorn.k.focused.text: Capricorn is a super focused sign, and can stay on something for as long as necessary. This is similar to Scorpio, but Scorpio has a hard time knowing when to stop, while Capricorn can see that and move on to something else with just as much focus.
explain.sign.capricorn.k.focused.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.authority.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Authority
explain.sign.capricorn.k.authority.text: Capricorn is one of the leaders of the Zodiac (along with Aries), and rules authority figures. Capricorn is the people in charge: bosses, politicians, governments, CEO's, corporations, institutions, captains, etc. The Capricorn leader is one who takes the responsibility seriously.
explain.sign.capricorn.k.authority.subject: Capricorn

explain.sign.capricorn.k.traditional.title: Capricorn in Astrology: Traditional
